decisions.name: Gloten v. National Labour Court (overtime for live-in caregivers)
decisions.court: Supreme Court of Israel (sitting as High Court of Justice)
decisions.q: Does the Hours of Work and Rest Law, with its overtime pay, apply to live-in caregivers?
decisions.q_id: Apakah UU Jam Kerja dan Istirahat, termasuk upah lembur, berlaku bagi perawat yang tinggal di rumah majikan?
decisions.held: No. The court held that the law’s overtime provisions do not apply to live-in caregivers because their working hours cannot be measured and supervised. [Check date.]
decisions.plain: A caregiver from the Philippines claimed overtime pay for round-the-clock care work. The Supreme Court said the overtime law does not fit live-in care work and refused the claim, while calling for legislation.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang perawat dari Filipina menuntut upah lembur untuk kerja perawatan sepanjang hari. MA menyatakan UU lembur tidak cocok untuk perawat yang tinggal di rumah majikan dan menolak tuntutannya, sambil meminta pembuat UU bertindak.

src.t: Supreme Court of Israel, judgments in English

decisions.name: Adam v. Knesset (three-year detention of asylum seekers)
decisions.court: Supreme Court of Israel (sitting as High Court of Justice)
decisions.q: May the law hold people who entered irregularly, mostly from Eritrea and Sudan, in detention for up to three years?
decisions.q_id: Bolehkah UU menahan orang yang masuk tanpa dokumen, kebanyakan dari Eritrea dan Sudan, hingga tiga tahun?
decisions.held: No. A nine-judge panel struck down the amendment to the Prevention of Infiltration Law as a disproportionate violation of liberty.
decisions.plain: Israel passed a law allowing people who crossed the border without papers to be held for up to three years. The Supreme Court struck it down. The Knesset then passed a new law, which led to the next cases.
decisions.plain_id: Israel membuat UU yang membolehkan orang yang melintasi perbatasan tanpa dokumen ditahan hingga tiga tahun. MA membatalkannya. Knesset lalu membuat UU baru, yang memicu perkara berikutnya.

after.en: New law creates the Holot facility.

src.t: Supreme Court of Israel, judgments in English

decisions.name: Eitan – Israeli Immigration Policy Center v. Government
decisions.court: Supreme Court of Israel (sitting as High Court of Justice)
decisions.q: After the first ruling, can the Knesset hold people for a year in closed detention and indefinitely in an “open” facility?
decisions.q_id: Setelah putusan pertama, bolehkah Knesset menahan orang setahun di tahanan tertutup dan tanpa batas di fasilitas “terbuka”?
decisions.held: No. The court struck down both the one-year detention and the open-ended stay at Holot.
decisions.plain: The Knesset’s second law also allowed long detention. The Supreme Court struck it down again and said a rule it had already cancelled could not come back in a slightly different form.
decisions.plain_id: UU kedua Knesset juga membolehkan penahanan lama. MA kembali membatalkannya dan menyatakan aturan yang sudah dibatalkan tidak bisa kembali dalam bentuk yang sedikit berbeda.

src.t: Supreme Court of Israel, judgments in English

decisions.name: Desta v. Knesset (length of stay at Holot)
decisions.court: Supreme Court of Israel (sitting as High Court of Justice)
decisions.q: Is a 20-month stay at the Holot facility proportionate?
decisions.q_id: Apakah tinggal 20 bulan di fasilitas Holot proporsional?
decisions.held: No. The court upheld the facility but held 20 months excessive and set 12 months as the limit until the law was amended.
decisions.plain: The third law allowed people to be held at Holot for 20 months. The Supreme Court allowed the facility but said 20 months was too long. Hundreds of people were released.
decisions.plain_id: UU ketiga membolehkan orang ditahan di Holot selama 20 bulan. MA membolehkan fasilitas itu tetapi menyatakan 20 bulan terlalu lama. Ratusan orang dibebaskan.

src.t: Supreme Court of Israel, judgments in English

decisions.name: Kav LaOved v. Knesset (deposit law)
decisions.court: Supreme Court of Israel (sitting as High Court of Justice)
decisions.q: May employers withhold 20 percent of an asylum seeker’s wages in a fund paid out only on leaving Israel?
decisions.q_id: Bolehkah majikan menahan 20 persen upah pencari suaka dalam dana yang baru dibayarkan saat meninggalkan Israel?
decisions.held: No. The deposit provision was struck down as a disproportionate violation of property rights; withheld money was to be returned.
decisions.plain: A law required employers to hold back a fifth of asylum seekers’ pay until they left the country. The Supreme Court cancelled it and ordered the money to be paid back.
decisions.plain_id: UU mewajibkan majikan menahan seperlima upah pencari suaka sampai mereka meninggalkan negara itu. MA membatalkannya dan memerintahkan uang itu dikembalikan.

src.t: Supreme Court of Israel, judgments in English

decisions.name: Recruitment agencies’ syndicate v. Ministry of Labour (standard contract)
decisions.q: Can the Ministry of Labour impose a new standard contract for migrant domestic workers?
decisions.q_id: Bisakah Kementerian Tenaga Kerja menetapkan kontrak standar baru bagi pekerja rumah tangga migran?
decisions.held: The council suspended the contract pending review, on the recruitment agencies’ argument that it breached freedom of contract and harmed their interests.
decisions.plain: Lebanon adopted a new contract giving domestic workers a weekly day off, limits on hours and the right to resign. Recruitment agencies challenged it, and the top administrative court suspended it.
decisions.plain_id: Lebanon menetapkan kontrak baru yang memberi pekerja rumah tangga hari libur mingguan, batas jam kerja, dan hak mengundurkan diri. Agen perekrut menggugatnya, dan pengadilan tata usaha tertinggi menangguhkannya.

decisions.name: Minister of Home Affairs v. Watchenuka
decisions.court: Supreme Court of Appeal, South Africa
decisions.q: May the state bar all asylum seekers from working and studying while their claims are decided?
decisions.q_id: Bolehkah negara melarang semua pencari suaka bekerja dan belajar selama permohonannya diproses?
decisions.held: No. A blanket ban on work and study for asylum seekers breaches human dignity; the decision must be made case by case.
decisions.plain: South Africa banned asylum seekers from working or studying while they waited, sometimes for years. The appeal court said a blanket ban breaks the right to dignity.
decisions.plain_id: Afrika Selatan melarang pencari suaka bekerja atau belajar selama menunggu, kadang bertahun-tahun. Pengadilan banding menyatakan larangan menyeluruh melanggar hak atas martabat.

src.t: South African Legal Information Institute / LawLibrary - confirmed via official search listing (judgment)

decisions.name: Somali Association of South Africa v. Limpopo Department of Economic Development
decisions.court: Supreme Court of Appeal, South Africa
decisions.q: Can refugees and asylum seekers be refused licences to run small shops?
decisions.q_id: Bisakah pengungsi dan pencari suaka ditolak izin membuka toko kecil?
decisions.held: Refugees may apply for trading licences; asylum seekers may do so where they cannot otherwise support themselves.
decisions.plain: Police closed hundreds of small shops run by Somali and Ethiopian traders in Limpopo. The court said refugees may get trading licences, and asylum seekers too when they have no other way to earn a living.
decisions.plain_id: Polisi menutup ratusan toko kecil milik pedagang Somalia dan Etiopia di Limpopo. Pengadilan menyatakan pengungsi boleh mendapat izin dagang, begitu pula pencari suaka jika tidak punya cara lain mencari nafkah.

src.t: South African Legal Information Institute / LawLibrary - confirmed via official search listing (judgment)

decisions.name: Khosa v. Minister of Social Development
decisions.q: May permanent residents be excluded from old-age and child grants?
decisions.q_id: Bolehkah penduduk tetap dikecualikan dari tunjangan hari tua dan tunjangan anak?
decisions.held: No. Excluding permanent residents from social assistance is unfair discrimination; “or permanent resident” was read into the Act.
decisions.plain: Mozambicans who were permanent residents in South Africa were denied pensions and child grants because they were not citizens. The Constitutional Court said they must be included.
decisions.plain_id: Warga Mozambik yang menjadi penduduk tetap di Afrika Selatan ditolak pensiun dan tunjangan anak karena bukan warga negara. MK menyatakan mereka harus diikutsertakan.

decisions.name: Lawyers for Human Rights v. Minister of Home Affairs
decisions.q: May immigration officers detain a person for deportation without bringing them before a court?
decisions.q_id: Bolehkah petugas imigrasi menahan seseorang untuk dideportasi tanpa membawanya ke pengadilan?
decisions.held: No. Section 34 of the Immigration Act was unconstitutional because it did not require a detained person to be brought before a court within 48 hours.
decisions.plain: People held for deportation in South Africa could be kept for weeks without seeing a judge. The Constitutional Court said they must appear before a court within 48 hours.
decisions.plain_id: Orang yang ditahan untuk dideportasi di Afrika Selatan bisa ditahan berminggu-minggu tanpa bertemu hakim. MK menyatakan mereka harus dihadapkan ke pengadilan dalam 48 jam.

after.en: Section 34 declared invalid; interim rules set.
after.id: Pasal 34 dinyatakan tidak sah; aturan sementara ditetapkan.

decisions.name: Mahlangu v. Minister of Labour
decisions.q: May domestic workers be excluded from compensation for injury and death at work?
decisions.q_id: Bolehkah pekerja rumah tangga dikecualikan dari kompensasi kecelakaan dan kematian kerja?
decisions.held: No. Excluding domestic workers from the compensation law is unfair discrimination on grounds of race, sex and gender; the ruling applies back to 1994.
decisions.plain: A domestic worker drowned in her employer’s pool and her family got nothing because the law left out domestic workers. The Constitutional Court said that was discrimination. The ruling covers many migrant domestic workers too.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang pekerja rumah tangga tenggelam di kolam renang majikan dan keluarganya tidak mendapat apa-apa karena UU tidak mencakup pekerja rumah tangga. MK menyatakan itu diskriminasi. Putusan ini juga melindungi banyak pekerja rumah tangga migran.

after.id: Pengecualian dinyatakan tidak sah, berlaku surut ke 1994.

after.en: Amendment Act extends cover to domestic workers. [Check.]
after.id: UU perubahan memperluas cakupan ke pekerja rumah tangga. [Periksa.]

decisions.name: Union of Refugee Women v. Director, Private Security Industry Regulatory Authority
decisions.q: May refugees be barred from registering as private security guards?
decisions.q_id: Bolehkah pengungsi dilarang mendaftar sebagai petugas keamanan swasta?
decisions.held: Yes, by majority. Limiting registration to citizens and permanent residents was a fair way to protect public safety; two judges dissented.
decisions.plain: Refugee women who wanted to work as security guards were refused because they were not citizens or permanent residents. The Constitutional Court, by majority, let the rule stand.
decisions.plain_id: Perempuan pengungsi yang ingin bekerja sebagai petugas keamanan ditolak karena bukan warga negara atau penduduk tetap. MK, dengan suara terbanyak, mempertahankan aturan itu.

decisions.name: Saidi v. Minister of Home Affairs
decisions.q: Must an asylum seeker’s permit be extended while a court reviews the refusal of their claim?
decisions.q_id: Haruskah izin pencari suaka diperpanjang selama pengadilan meninjau penolakan permohonannya?
decisions.held: Yes. The permit remains in force, and must be extended, until judicial review is finished.
decisions.plain: Asylum seekers whose claims were refused lost their papers while they challenged the refusal in court, so they could be arrested or lose their jobs. The court said the papers must stay valid until the case ends.
decisions.plain_id: Pencari suaka yang permohonannya ditolak kehilangan dokumen selama menggugat penolakan itu, sehingga bisa ditangkap atau kehilangan pekerjaan. Pengadilan menyatakan dokumen harus tetap berlaku sampai perkara selesai.

decisions.name: Ruta v. Minister of Home Affairs
decisions.q: Can a person who did not claim asylum straight away be deported without their claim being heard?
decisions.q_id: Bisakah orang yang tidak segera mengajukan suaka dideportasi tanpa permohonannya didengar?
decisions.held: No. Delay does not cancel the right to apply for asylum, and the non-refoulement principle applies until the claim is decided.
decisions.plain: A Rwandan man arrested for being in South Africa without papers said he feared going home. The court said he must be allowed to claim asylum first, even though he had waited.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang pria Rwanda yang ditangkap karena berada di Afrika Selatan tanpa dokumen mengaku takut pulang. Pengadilan menyatakan ia harus diberi kesempatan mengajukan suaka dulu, meski sudah menunda.

decisions.name: Minister of Home Affairs v. Scalabrini Centre (Cape Town reception office)
decisions.court: Supreme Court of Appeal, South Africa
decisions.q: Was it lawful to close the Cape Town refugee reception office to new applicants?
decisions.q_id: Apakah sah menutup kantor penerimaan pengungsi di Cape Town bagi pemohon baru?
decisions.held: No. The closure was irrational and unlawful; the office was to reopen for new applicants by a set date. [Check date.]
decisions.plain: The government stopped accepting new asylum applications in Cape Town, so people had to travel far to apply. The appeal court said the closure was unlawful and ordered the office to reopen.
decisions.plain_id: Pemerintah berhenti menerima permohonan suaka baru di Cape Town sehingga orang harus bepergian jauh untuk mendaftar. Pengadilan banding menyatakan penutupan itu tidak sah dan memerintahkan kantor dibuka kembali.

decisions.name: Nandutu v. Minister of Home Affairs
decisions.q: Must foreign spouses of citizens leave the country to change their visa?
decisions.q_id: Haruskah pasangan asing warga negara meninggalkan negara itu untuk mengganti visa?
decisions.held: No. Requiring spouses and children of citizens and permanent residents to apply from abroad breached dignity; the rule was read to allow applications in the country.
decisions.plain: Foreign husbands and wives of South Africans had to leave the country to switch from a visitor visa to a spouse visa. The Constitutional Court said they may apply without leaving.
decisions.plain_id: Suami atau istri asing warga Afrika Selatan harus keluar negeri untuk mengganti visa kunjungan menjadi visa pasangan. MK menyatakan mereka boleh mengajukan tanpa keluar.

decisions.name: Dawood v. Minister of Home Affairs
decisions.q: May immigration officials refuse foreign spouses temporary permits without any guidance on how to decide?
decisions.q_id: Bolehkah petugas imigrasi menolak izin sementara bagi pasangan asing tanpa pedoman cara memutuskan?
decisions.held: No. The right to dignity protects the right to live together as spouses, and unguided discretion to refuse permits breached it.
decisions.plain: Foreign spouses of South Africans were refused permits to stay while their residence applications were decided, with no rules for officials to follow. The Constitutional Court said this breached the right to family life.
decisions.plain_id: Pasangan asing warga Afrika Selatan ditolak izin tinggal selama permohonan izin tetapnya diproses, tanpa aturan bagi petugas. MK menyatakan ini melanggar hak atas kehidupan keluarga.

after.en: Immigration Act 2002 replaces the old law.

decisions.name: Kituo cha Sheria v. Attorney General (urban refugees)
decisions.q: May the government order all urban refugees to move to camps?
decisions.q_id: Bolehkah pemerintah memerintahkan semua pengungsi di kota pindah ke kamp?
decisions.held: No. The directive breached freedom of movement and the rule against refoulement and was quashed.
decisions.plain: Kenya ordered refugees living and working in cities to move to camps. The High Court said the order was unlawful because it took away their freedom of movement.
decisions.plain_id: Kenya memerintahkan pengungsi yang tinggal dan bekerja di kota pindah ke kamp. Pengadilan Tinggi menyatakan perintah itu tidak sah karena merampas kebebasan bergerak mereka.

decisions.name: KNCHR v. Attorney General (closure of Dadaab)
decisions.q: Can the government close the Dadaab camp and send Somali refugees home as a group?
decisions.q_id: Bisakah pemerintah menutup kamp Dadaab dan memulangkan pengungsi Somalia secara berkelompok?
decisions.held: No. The directive was unconstitutional and amounted to group persecution and refoulement.
decisions.plain: Kenya announced it would close Dadaab, one of the world’s largest refugee camps, and return Somali refugees. The High Court said this was unconstitutional.
decisions.plain_id: Kenya mengumumkan akan menutup Dadaab, salah satu kamp pengungsi terbesar di dunia, dan memulangkan pengungsi Somalia. Pengadilan Tinggi menyatakan ini inkonstitusional.

decisions.name: RADDHO v. Zambia
decisions.court: African Commission on Human and Peoples’ Rights
decisions.q: Was Zambia’s expulsion of 517 West Africans lawful?
decisions.q_id: Apakah pengusiran 517 warga Afrika Barat oleh Zambia sah?
decisions.held: No. The mass expulsion, without a chance to challenge it in court, breached the African Charter.
decisions.plain: Zambia rounded up 517 people from West Africa, held them in a camp and flew them out without letting them go to court. The African Commission said this broke the African Charter.
decisions.plain_id: Zambia menangkap 517 orang dari Afrika Barat, menahan mereka di kamp, dan menerbangkan mereka keluar tanpa kesempatan ke pengadilan. Komisi Afrika menyatakan ini melanggar Piagam Afrika.

decisions.name: Union Inter-Africaine des Droits de l’Homme v. Angola
decisions.court: African Commission on Human and Peoples’ Rights
decisions.q: Was Angola’s round-up and expulsion of West African workers lawful?
decisions.q_id: Apakah penangkapan dan pengusiran pekerja Afrika Barat oleh Angola sah?
decisions.held: No. Mass expulsion of non-nationals is a special violation of human rights; the expelled lost their property and work.
decisions.plain: Angola arrested and expelled hundreds of people from West Africa, many working in diamond areas, without any court process. The African Commission said mass expulsion is forbidden.
decisions.plain_id: Angola menangkap dan mengusir ratusan orang dari Afrika Barat, banyak yang bekerja di kawasan berlian, tanpa proses pengadilan. Komisi Afrika menyatakan pengusiran massal dilarang.

src.t: AfricanLII - confirmed via official search listing (judgment)

decisions.name: IHRDA v. Angola
decisions.court: African Commission on Human and Peoples’ Rights
decisions.q: Was the detention and expulsion of a Gambian man during a 2004 round-up lawful?
decisions.q_id: Apakah penahanan dan pengusiran seorang pria Gambia dalam razia 2004 sah?
decisions.held: No. Detention in poor conditions without access to a court and summary expulsion breached the Charter.
decisions.plain: A Gambian man working in Angola was arrested in a large sweep, held in bad conditions and expelled without a hearing. The African Commission found Angola breached the Charter.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang pria Gambia yang bekerja di Angola ditangkap dalam razia besar, ditahan dalam kondisi buruk, dan diusir tanpa sidang. Komisi Afrika menyatakan Angola melanggar Piagam.

decisions.name: OMCT and others v. Rwanda
decisions.court: African Commission on Human and Peoples’ Rights
decisions.q: Could Rwanda expel Burundian refugees as a group?
decisions.q_id: Bisakah Rwanda mengusir pengungsi Burundi secara berkelompok?
decisions.held: No. Expelling people because of their nationality, without individual decisions, breached the Charter.
decisions.plain: Rwanda expelled Burundian refugees as a group because of their nationality. The African Commission said each person must be considered individually.
decisions.plain_id: Rwanda mengusir pengungsi Burundi secara berkelompok karena kewarganegaraannya. Komisi Afrika menyatakan setiap orang harus dipertimbangkan satu per satu.

src.t: AfricanLII - confirmed via official search listing (judgment)

decisions.name: IHRDA (on behalf of Sierra Leonean refugees) v. Guinea
decisions.court: African Commission on Human and Peoples’ Rights
decisions.q: Was Guinea responsible for attacks on Sierra Leonean refugees after a speech by its president?
decisions.q_id: Apakah Guinea bertanggung jawab atas serangan terhadap pengungsi Sierra Leone setelah pidato presidennya?
decisions.held: Yes. The speech incited soldiers and civilians to attack refugees, and the resulting abuse and forced departures breached the Charter.
decisions.plain: After Guinea’s president said in a radio speech that refugees should be sent home, soldiers and civilians attacked Sierra Leonean refugees. The African Commission held Guinea responsible.
decisions.plain_id: Setelah presiden Guinea mengatakan di radio bahwa pengungsi harus dipulangkan, tentara dan warga menyerang pengungsi Sierra Leone. Komisi Afrika menyatakan Guinea bertanggung jawab.

decisions.name: Amnesty International v. Zambia
decisions.court: African Commission on Human and Peoples’ Rights
decisions.q: Could Zambia deport two long-resident politicians as “prohibited immigrants” without a hearing?
decisions.q_id: Bisakah Zambia mendeportasi dua politisi yang lama tinggal di sana sebagai “imigran terlarang” tanpa sidang?
decisions.held: No. Deporting them without a chance to challenge the decision, and separating them from their families, breached the Charter.
decisions.plain: Zambia deported two opposition figures who had lived there for decades, calling them prohibited immigrants. The African Commission said they had a right to be heard first.
decisions.plain_id: Zambia mendeportasi dua tokoh oposisi yang sudah tinggal puluhan tahun di sana dengan menyebut mereka imigran terlarang. Komisi Afrika menyatakan mereka berhak didengar dulu.

decisions.name: Kenneth Good v. Botswana
decisions.court: African Commission on Human and Peoples’ Rights
decisions.q: Could Botswana expel a foreign professor for criticising the government, without reasons or appeal?
decisions.q_id: Bisakah Botswana mengusir dosen asing karena mengkritik pemerintah, tanpa alasan dan tanpa banding?
decisions.held: No. The expulsion, with no reasons given and no access to a court, breached the rights to a hearing and to free expression.
decisions.plain: A foreign professor in Botswana wrote an article criticising how presidents were chosen and was declared a prohibited immigrant. The African Commission found this breached his rights.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang dosen asing di Botswana menulis artikel yang mengkritik cara memilih presiden dan dinyatakan imigran terlarang. Komisi Afrika menyatakan haknya dilanggar.

after.en: Decision adopted; Botswana said it would not comply. [Check.]
after.id: Keputusan diambil; Botswana menyatakan tidak akan mematuhi. [Periksa.]

decisions.name: IHRDA and OSJI (children of Nubian descent) v. Kenya
decisions.court: African Committee of Experts on the Rights and Welfare of the Child
decisions.q: Did Kenya’s treatment of Nubian children leave them at risk of statelessness?
decisions.q_id: Apakah perlakuan Kenya terhadap anak keturunan Nubia membuat mereka berisiko tanpa kewarganegaraan?
decisions.held: Yes. Kenya breached the children’s right to a nationality and to non-discrimination and must ensure they acquire Kenyan nationality at birth.
decisions.plain: Nubians, brought to Kenya as soldiers in colonial times, struggled for generations to get Kenyan papers. The African children’s rights committee said their children must get nationality at birth.
decisions.plain_id: Warga Nubia, yang dibawa ke Kenya sebagai tentara di masa kolonial, bergenerasi kesulitan mendapat dokumen Kenya. Komite hak anak Afrika menyatakan anak mereka harus mendapat kewarganegaraan sejak lahir.

decisions.name: Anudo Ochieng Anudo v. Tanzania
decisions.court: African Court on Human and Peoples’ Rights
decisions.q: Could Tanzania strip a man of his nationality and expel him to Kenya without a court hearing?
decisions.q_id: Bisakah Tanzania mencabut kewarganegaraan seseorang dan mengusirnya ke Kenya tanpa sidang pengadilan?
decisions.held: No. The deprivation of nationality was arbitrary, and expelling him without a chance to challenge it breached the Charter and the ICCPR.
decisions.plain: Tanzania declared a man an illegal immigrant, took his passport and expelled him to Kenya, which also refused him. He was left stateless. The African Court said Tanzania must restore his rights.
decisions.plain_id: Tanzania menyatakan seorang pria imigran ilegal, menyita paspornya, dan mengusirnya ke Kenya, yang juga menolaknya. Ia menjadi tanpa kewarganegaraan. Mahkamah Afrika menyatakan Tanzania harus memulihkan haknya.

src.t: AfricanLII - confirmed via official search listing (judgment)

decisions.name: Robert John Penessis v. Tanzania
decisions.court: African Court on Human and Peoples’ Rights
decisions.q: Was the detention of a man as an illegal immigrant, when he claimed Tanzanian nationality, lawful?
decisions.q_id: Apakah penahanan seseorang sebagai imigran ilegal, padahal ia mengaku warga Tanzania, sah?
decisions.held: No. The state had to prove he was not a national; his detention and the denial of nationality were arbitrary.
decisions.plain: A man born in Tanzania was arrested and held for years as an illegal immigrant. The African Court said the state, not the man, had to prove he was a foreigner.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang pria kelahiran Tanzania ditangkap dan ditahan bertahun-tahun sebagai imigran ilegal. Mahkamah Afrika menyatakan negara, bukan pria itu, yang harus membuktikan ia orang asing.

decisions.name: Attorney General v. Unity Dow
decisions.q: May a mother who is a citizen be unable to pass citizenship to children whose father is foreign?
decisions.q_id: Bolehkah ibu yang warga negara tidak bisa menurunkan kewarganegaraan kepada anak yang ayahnya orang asing?
decisions.held: No. The Citizenship Act discriminated on grounds of sex and was unconstitutional.
decisions.plain: Botswana’s law gave citizenship to children through their father only. A woman married to an American challenged it. The court said the law was unfair to women.
decisions.plain_id: UU Botswana memberikan kewarganegaraan kepada anak hanya melalui ayah. Seorang perempuan yang menikah dengan warga AS menggugatnya. Pengadilan menyatakan UU itu tidak adil bagi perempuan.

decisions.name: Rattigan v. Chief Immigration Officer
decisions.q: May a citizen wife’s foreign husband be refused the right to live and work in Zimbabwe?
decisions.q_id: Bolehkah suami asing dari istri warga negara ditolak haknya tinggal dan bekerja di Zimbabwe?
decisions.held: No. Refusing residence to the foreign husband breached the wife’s freedom of movement, which includes living in Zimbabwe with her family.
decisions.plain: Zimbabwean women married to foreign men found their husbands could not get residence. The Supreme Court said a woman’s right to live in her country includes living there with her husband.
decisions.plain_id: Perempuan Zimbabwe yang menikah dengan pria asing mendapati suami mereka tidak bisa mendapat izin tinggal. MA menyatakan hak perempuan tinggal di negaranya termasuk tinggal bersama suaminya.

decisions.name: Advisory Opinion OC-16/99 (consular assistance and due process)
decisions.q: Must foreigners who are arrested be told they can contact their consulate, and what follows if they are not?
decisions.q_id: Haruskah orang asing yang ditangkap diberi tahu haknya menghubungi konsulat, dan apa akibatnya jika tidak?
decisions.held: Yes. The right to consular information is part of due process; imposing the death penalty without it violates the right not to be arbitrarily deprived of life.
decisions.plain: Mexico asked the Inter-American Court about Mexican nationals sentenced to death abroad without being told they could call their consulate. The Court said this right is part of a fair trial.
decisions.plain_id: Meksiko bertanya kepada Mahkamah Inter-Amerika tentang warga Meksiko yang dihukum mati di luar negeri tanpa diberi tahu haknya menghubungi konsulat. Mahkamah menyatakan hak ini bagian dari peradilan yang adil.

after.en: ICJ reaches a similar view in Avena.
after.id: ICJ mencapai pandangan serupa dalam Avena.

decisions.name: Advisory Opinion OC-21/14 (children in migration)
decisions.q: What must states do when children migrate, alone or with their families?
decisions.q_id: Apa yang wajib dilakukan negara ketika anak bermigrasi, sendiri atau bersama keluarga?
decisions.held: States may not detain children for migration reasons; they must find alternatives that keep families together and assess each child’s need for protection.
decisions.plain: Argentina, Brazil, Paraguay and Uruguay asked the Inter-American Court about migrant children. The Court said children must not be locked up for immigration reasons.
decisions.plain_id: Argentina, Brasil, Paraguay, dan Uruguay bertanya kepada Mahkamah Inter-Amerika tentang anak migran. Mahkamah menyatakan anak tidak boleh ditahan karena alasan imigrasi.

decisions.name: Advisory Opinion OC-25/18 (asylum)
decisions.q: What does the right to seek asylum require, including at embassies?
decisions.q_id: Apa yang dituntut hak mencari suaka, termasuk di kedutaan?
decisions.held: The right to seek and receive asylum and the rule against return to danger bind states; diplomatic asylum is not covered by the American Convention.
decisions.plain: Ecuador asked the Inter-American Court about asylum. The Court said people must not be sent back to danger, but asylum inside embassies is a matter for each state.
decisions.plain_id: Ekuador bertanya kepada Mahkamah Inter-Amerika tentang suaka. Mahkamah menyatakan orang tidak boleh dipulangkan ke bahaya, tetapi suaka di kedutaan diserahkan kepada tiap negara.

decisions.name: Pacheco Tineo Family v. Bolivia
decisions.q: Did Bolivia breach the rights of a Peruvian family by expelling them within days without hearing their asylum claim?
decisions.q_id: Apakah Bolivia melanggar hak keluarga asal Peru dengan mengusir mereka dalam hitungan hari tanpa mendengar permohonan suakanya?
decisions.held: Yes. Asylum and expulsion procedures require due process, and the family’s rights, including those of the children, were breached.
decisions.plain: A Peruvian family asked for asylum in Bolivia and were sent back to Peru within days. The Inter-American Court said Bolivia should have heard their claim properly.
decisions.plain_id: Sebuah keluarga Peru meminta suaka di Bolivia dan dipulangkan ke Peru dalam hitungan hari. Mahkamah Inter-Amerika menyatakan Bolivia seharusnya memeriksa permohonan mereka dengan benar.

decisions.name: Workers of the Hacienda Brasil Verde v. Brazil
decisions.q: Was Brazil responsible for slavery on a ranch where workers recruited from poorer states were held by debt?
decisions.q_id: Apakah Brasil bertanggung jawab atas perbudakan di peternakan tempat pekerja dari negara bagian miskin dijerat utang?
decisions.held: Yes. Brazil failed to prevent slavery and to investigate and punish it; the Court found structural discrimination based on economic position.
decisions.plain: Men recruited from poor regions of Brazil were taken to a remote ranch and kept working by debt and threats. It was the Inter-American Court’s first judgment on slavery, and it found Brazil responsible.
decisions.plain_id: Pria yang direkrut dari wilayah miskin Brasil dibawa ke peternakan terpencil dan dipaksa bekerja dengan utang dan ancaman. Ini putusan pertama Mahkamah Inter-Amerika tentang perbudakan, dan Brasil dinyatakan bertanggung jawab.

decisions.name: Roche Azaña v. Nicaragua
decisions.q: Was Nicaragua responsible when officers fired on a vehicle carrying migrants, and then left the survivor out of the trial?
decisions.q_id: Apakah Nikaragua bertanggung jawab saat petugas menembaki kendaraan berisi migran, lalu tidak melibatkan korban selamat dalam persidangan?
decisions.held: Yes. The use of lethal force was unlawful, and the survivor was denied access to justice because he was not told of or included in the proceedings.
decisions.plain: Officers shot at a van carrying Ecuadorian migrants heading north, killing one brother and wounding the other. The survivor was never told about the trial. The Inter-American Court found Nicaragua responsible.
decisions.plain_id: Petugas menembaki van berisi migran Ekuador yang menuju utara, menewaskan satu bersaudara dan melukai yang lain. Korban selamat tidak pernah diberi tahu tentang persidangan. Mahkamah Inter-Amerika menyatakan Nikaragua bertanggung jawab.

decisions.name: Wong Ho Wing v. Peru
decisions.q: Would extraditing a Chinese national to face trial at home breach his right to life, and was his long detention lawful?
decisions.q_id: Apakah mengekstradisi warga Tiongkok untuk diadili di negaranya melanggar hak hidupnya, dan apakah penahanannya yang lama sah?
decisions.held: Extradition would not breach the Convention given diplomatic assurances; but his detention for over six years without proper review breached personal liberty.
decisions.plain: A Chinese businessman held in Peru fought extradition, fearing the death penalty. The Inter-American Court said Peru could extradite him, but had held him far too long.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang pengusaha Tiongkok yang ditahan di Peru melawan ekstradisi karena takut hukuman mati. Mahkamah Inter-Amerika menyatakan Peru boleh mengekstradisi, tetapi menahannya terlalu lama.

decisions.name: Random migration checks on roads (Amparo en revisión 275/2019)
decisions.court: Supreme Court of Justice of Mexico (First Chamber)
decisions.q: May immigration officers stop people on roads to check their migration status?
decisions.q_id: Bolehkah petugas imigrasi menghentikan orang di jalan untuk memeriksa status imigrasinya?
decisions.held: No. The migration review provisions breached freedom of movement and led to racial profiling, including of Mexican citizens.
decisions.plain: Three Indigenous Mexicans were pulled off a bus by immigration officers who assumed they were Guatemalan. The Supreme Court said random migration checks on roads are unconstitutional.
decisions.plain_id: Tiga warga adat Meksiko diturunkan dari bus oleh petugas imigrasi yang mengira mereka warga Guatemala. MA menyatakan pemeriksaan imigrasi acak di jalan inkonstitusional.

decisions.name: 36-hour limit in migration stations (Amparo en revisión 388/2022)
decisions.court: Supreme Court of Justice of Mexico (First Chamber)
decisions.q: How long may migrants be held in a migration station?
decisions.q_id: Berapa lama migran boleh ditahan di stasiun migrasi?
decisions.held: No more than 36 hours; after that people must continue their migration procedure at liberty.
decisions.plain: A man was held for a long time in the migration station in Matamoros. The Supreme Court said nobody may be held in such a station for more than 36 hours.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang pria ditahan lama di stasiun migrasi Matamoros. MA menyatakan tidak seorang pun boleh ditahan di stasiun itu lebih dari 36 jam.

decisions.name: Health care for Venezuelan migrants (T-210/18)
decisions.q: Must public hospitals treat migrants without papers beyond the bare emergency?
decisions.q_id: Haruskah rumah sakit umum merawat migran tanpa dokumen lebih dari sekadar darurat?
decisions.held: Yes. Emergency care for undocumented migrants can include treatment for serious illness such as cancer, and the state must help them regularise to join the health system.
decisions.plain: A Venezuelan woman with cancer and a sick child were refused treatment in Colombia because they had no papers. The Constitutional Court said emergency care must cover their serious illnesses.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang perempuan Venezuela penderita kanker dan anaknya yang sakit ditolak berobat di Kolombia karena tidak punya dokumen. MK menyatakan layanan darurat harus mencakup penyakit serius mereka.

after.en: Temporary Protection Statute for Venezuelans. [Not a result of the case alone.]
after.id: Status Perlindungan Sementara bagi warga Venezuela. [Bukan semata akibat perkara ini.]

decisions.name: Social assistance for foreign residents (RE 587.970)
decisions.q: Do foreign residents have the right to the continuous cash benefit for older and disabled people?
decisions.q_id: Apakah penduduk asing berhak atas tunjangan tunai berkelanjutan bagi lansia dan penyandang disabilitas?
decisions.held: Yes. Foreigners resident in Brazil who meet the conditions are entitled to the benefit on the same footing as nationals.
decisions.plain: An Italian woman who had lived in Brazil for decades was refused the old-age benefit because she was not Brazilian. The Supreme Court said residents are entitled to it like citizens.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang perempuan Italia yang sudah puluhan tahun tinggal di Brasil ditolak tunjangan lansia karena bukan warga Brasil. MA Federal menyatakan penduduk berhak seperti warga negara.

decisions.name: The “dirty list” of employers using slave labour (ADPF 509)
decisions.q: May the government publish a list of employers found using labour analogous to slavery?
decisions.q_id: Bolehkah pemerintah menerbitkan daftar majikan yang terbukti memakai kerja yang setara perbudakan?
decisions.held: Yes. The register is constitutional; it is a transparency measure based on administrative findings after due process.
decisions.plain: Brazil publishes the names of employers found using slave-like labour, including of migrant workers in garment workshops. An employers’ association challenged the list, and the Supreme Court upheld it.
decisions.plain_id: Brasil menerbitkan nama majikan yang terbukti memakai kerja mirip perbudakan, termasuk pekerja migran di bengkel garmen. Asosiasi pengusaha menggugat daftar itu, dan MA Federal mempertahankannya.

decisions.name: Chairman, Railway Board v. Chandrima Das
decisions.q: Can a Bangladeshi woman, not an Indian citizen, claim compensation for rape by railway employees?
decisions.q_id: Bisakah perempuan Bangladesh, bukan warga India, menuntut ganti rugi atas pemerkosaan oleh pegawai kereta api?
decisions.held: Yes. The right to life and dignity under Article 21 protects every person, citizen or not; the Railways were liable to pay compensation.
decisions.plain: A woman from Bangladesh was raped by railway staff at a station in Kolkata. The Supreme Court said the right to life protects foreigners too and ordered the railways to pay her.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang perempuan dari Bangladesh diperkosa staf kereta api di stasiun Kolkata. MA menyatakan hak hidup juga melindungi orang asing dan memerintahkan perusahaan kereta api membayar ganti rugi.

decisions.name: National Human Rights Commission v. State of Arunachal Pradesh
decisions.q: Must the state protect Chakma refugees threatened with forced eviction by local groups?
decisions.q_id: Wajibkah negara melindungi pengungsi Chakma yang diancam diusir paksa oleh kelompok setempat?
decisions.held: Yes. The state must protect the life and liberty of every person, including non-citizens, and must process their citizenship applications.
decisions.plain: Chakma families who had lived in Arunachal Pradesh for decades were threatened with being driven out. The Supreme Court ordered the state to protect them and to deal with their citizenship claims.
decisions.plain_id: Keluarga Chakma yang puluhan tahun tinggal di Arunachal Pradesh diancam diusir. MA memerintahkan negara bagian melindungi mereka dan memproses permohonan kewarganegaraan mereka.

after.en: Supreme Court orders citizenship to be granted. [Check.]

decisions.name: Louis De Raedt v. Union of India
decisions.q: Do foreigners who have lived in India for decades have a right to stay?
decisions.q_id: Apakah orang asing yang sudah puluhan tahun tinggal di India berhak tetap tinggal?
decisions.held: No. A foreigner’s right to life and liberty is protected, but the right to reside and settle is reserved to citizens; the power to expel is unlimited by the Constitution.
decisions.plain: Foreign missionaries who had lived in India since before independence were told to leave. The Supreme Court said foreigners have no right to stay, though their lives and liberty are protected.
decisions.plain_id: Misionaris asing yang tinggal di India sejak sebelum kemerdekaan disuruh pergi. MA menyatakan orang asing tidak berhak tinggal, meski hidup dan kebebasannya dilindungi.

decisions.name: Mohammad Salimullah v. Union of India
decisions.q: Should the court stop the deportation of Rohingya refugees held in Jammu?
decisions.q_id: Haruskah pengadilan menghentikan deportasi pengungsi Rohingya yang ditahan di Jammu?
decisions.held: No interim relief. The court declined to halt deportation, saying it would follow the procedure for deportation; the main petition is pending.
decisions.plain: Rohingya refugees detained in Jammu asked the Supreme Court to stop their deportation to Myanmar. The court refused to stop it for now.
decisions.plain_id: Pengungsi Rohingya yang ditahan di Jammu meminta MA menghentikan deportasi mereka ke Myanmar. Pengadilan menolak menghentikannya untuk sementara.

decisions.name: Md. Sadaqat Khan (Fakku) v. Chief Election Commissioner
decisions.court: High Court Division, Supreme Court of Bangladesh
decisions.q: Are Urdu-speaking “Biharis” living in camps citizens who can register to vote?
decisions.q_id: Apakah warga “Bihari” berbahasa Urdu yang tinggal di kamp adalah warga negara yang boleh terdaftar sebagai pemilih?
decisions.held: Yes. They are citizens of Bangladesh by law and must be registered on the voters’ list.
decisions.plain: Urdu-speaking people who stayed in Bangladesh after 1971 lived for decades in camps without recognition as citizens. The High Court said they are citizens and must be allowed to vote.
decisions.plain_id: Warga berbahasa Urdu yang tetap tinggal di Bangladesh setelah 1971 hidup puluhan tahun di kamp tanpa diakui sebagai warga negara. Pengadilan Tinggi menyatakan mereka warga negara dan berhak memilih.

after.en: Many camp residents vote in the general election. [Check.]
after.id: Banyak penghuni kamp memilih dalam pemilu. [Periksa.]

decisions.name: Ghulam Rbani v. Secretary for Justice
decisions.court: Court of Final Appeal, Hong Kong
decisions.q: Was the immigration detention of a Pakistani man lawful when officers did not consider whether it was needed?
decisions.q_id: Apakah penahanan imigrasi seorang pria Pakistan sah ketika petugas tidak menimbang perlunya penahanan?
decisions.held: No. Detention requires an actual decision applying the published policy; without it, part of the detention was unlawful and damages were due.
decisions.plain: A Pakistani man was held for weeks by Hong Kong immigration officers without anyone deciding whether he needed to be held. The top court said that part of his detention was unlawful.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang pria Pakistan ditahan berminggu-minggu oleh petugas imigrasi Hong Kong tanpa ada yang memutuskan apakah ia perlu ditahan. Pengadilan tertinggi menyatakan sebagian penahanan itu tidak sah.

decisions.name: Saudi Arabian Airlines v. Rebesencio
decisions.q: Can Filipino flight attendants who were pushed out of a foreign airline for being pregnant sue in the Philippines?
decisions.q_id: Bisakah pramugari Filipina yang dipaksa keluar dari maskapai asing karena hamil menggugat di Filipina?
decisions.held: Yes. Philippine courts had jurisdiction and Philippine law applied; the women were illegally dismissed. [Check reasoning on choice of law.]
decisions.plain: A foreign airline forced Filipino cabin crew to resign when they became pregnant. The Supreme Court said they could sue at home and that their dismissal was unlawful.
decisions.plain_id: Sebuah maskapai asing memaksa awak kabin Filipina mengundurkan diri saat hamil. MA menyatakan mereka boleh menggugat di negaranya sendiri dan pemecatan itu tidak sah.

decisions.name: Neeraja Chaudhary v. State of Madhya Pradesh
decisions.q: Is it enough to free bonded labourers, or must the state also help them rebuild their lives?
decisions.q_id: Cukupkah membebaskan pekerja ijon, atau wajibkah negara juga membantu mereka membangun hidup kembali?
decisions.held: Release must be followed by rehabilitation; failing to rehabilitate freed bonded labourers breaches Article 21.
decisions.plain: Workers brought from other states to quarries near Delhi were freed from debt bondage but left with nothing. The Supreme Court said the state must also help them start again.
decisions.plain_id: Pekerja yang dibawa dari negara bagian lain ke tambang batu dekat Delhi dibebaskan dari jeratan utang tetapi dibiarkan tanpa apa-apa. MA menyatakan negara juga wajib membantu mereka memulai lagi.

decisions.name: Ahmadou Sadio Diallo (Guinea v. Democratic Republic of the Congo)
decisions.q: Did the DRC breach the rights of a Guinean businessman by detaining and expelling him?
decisions.q_id: Apakah RD Kongo melanggar hak seorang pengusaha Guinea dengan menahan dan mengusirnya?
decisions.held: Yes. His arrest, detention and expulsion breached the ICCPR and the African Charter, and he was not told he could contact his consulate; compensation was set in 2012.
decisions.plain: A businessman from Guinea who had lived in Congo for 32 years was arrested and expelled after a business dispute. The International Court of Justice found Congo broke international law.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang pengusaha dari Guinea yang 32 tahun tinggal di Kongo ditangkap dan diusir setelah sengketa bisnis. Mahkamah Internasional menyatakan Kongo melanggar hukum internasional.

decisions.name: Jadhav (India v. Pakistan)
decisions.q: Did Pakistan breach the Vienna Convention by denying consular access to an Indian national sentenced to death?
decisions.q_id: Apakah Pakistan melanggar Konvensi Wina dengan menolak akses konsuler bagi warga India yang dihukum mati?
decisions.held: Yes. Pakistan must review and reconsider the conviction and sentence, and the execution must be stayed meanwhile.
decisions.plain: An Indian man was sentenced to death by a military court in Pakistan without his consulate being allowed to see him. The International Court of Justice said Pakistan must review the case.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang pria India dihukum mati oleh pengadilan militer di Pakistan tanpa konsulatnya diizinkan menemuinya. Mahkamah Internasional menyatakan Pakistan harus meninjau perkara itu.

after.en: Pakistan passes an ordinance allowing review. [Check.]
after.id: Pakistan menerbitkan peraturan yang membolehkan peninjauan. [Periksa.]

decisions.name: Article 26 complaint concerning Qatar (Forced Labour and Labour Inspection Conventions)
decisions.q: How should the ILO deal with a complaint about the treatment of migrant workers in Qatar?
decisions.q_id: Bagaimana ILO menangani pengaduan tentang perlakuan terhadap pekerja migran di Qatar?
decisions.held: The Governing Body closed the complaint after the government agreed a three-year technical cooperation programme with the ILO.
decisions.plain: Worker delegates at the ILO filed a complaint in 2014 about migrant workers in Qatar. In 2017 the ILO closed it when Qatar agreed a programme of labour reforms with the ILO.
decisions.plain_id: Delegasi pekerja di ILO mengajukan pengaduan pada 2014 tentang pekerja migran di Qatar. Pada 2017 ILO menutupnya ketika Qatar menyepakati program reformasi ketenagakerjaan dengan ILO.

after.id: Pengaduan ditutup; program kerja sama disepakati.

after.en: Laws changed on changing employer and a minimum wage. [Check.]
after.id: UU diubah tentang pindah majikan dan upah minimum. [Periksa.]

decisions.name: Case No. 2227 (United States): remedies for undocumented workers after Hoffman Plastic
decisions.court: ILO Committee on Freedom of Association
decisions.q: Does denying back pay to undocumented workers dismissed for union activity meet freedom of association standards?
decisions.q_id: Apakah menolak upah tertunggak bagi pekerja tanpa dokumen yang dipecat karena berserikat memenuhi standar kebebasan berserikat?
decisions.held: No. Without back pay, the remaining remedies did not adequately protect undocumented workers against anti-union discrimination.
decisions.plain: After the US Supreme Court denied back pay to an undocumented worker fired for organising, unions complained to the ILO. The ILO committee said the remaining remedies were not enough.
decisions.plain_id: Setelah MA AS menolak upah tertunggak bagi pekerja tanpa dokumen yang dipecat karena berserikat, serikat pekerja mengadu ke ILO. Komite ILO menyatakan sisa pemulihan tidak memadai.

decisions.name: Undocumented Workers v. United States (Report No. 50/16)
decisions.q: Does US labour law protect undocumented workers equally?
decisions.q_id: Apakah hukum ketenagakerjaan AS melindungi pekerja tanpa dokumen secara setara?
decisions.held: No. Barring undocumented workers from some remedies breached equality and the right to work and fair conditions under the American Declaration.
decisions.plain: Undocumented workers injured at work or not paid in the US took their case to the Inter-American Commission. It said the US must give them the same labour protection as others.
decisions.plain_id: Pekerja tanpa dokumen yang cedera atau tidak dibayar di AS membawa perkaranya ke Komisi Inter-Amerika. Komisi menyatakan AS wajib memberi mereka perlindungan kerja yang sama.

decisions.name: Toussaint v. Canada
decisions.q: Did excluding an irregular migrant from federal health coverage breach her right to life?
decisions.q_id: Apakah mengecualikan migran tanpa dokumen dari jaminan kesehatan federal melanggar hak hidupnya?
decisions.held: Yes. Denying coverage where her life was at risk breached the rights to life and to non-discrimination.
decisions.plain: A woman from Grenada living in Canada without status was refused health coverage when she was seriously ill. The UN Human Rights Committee said this put her life at risk and broke the treaty.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang perempuan dari Grenada yang tinggal di Kanada tanpa status ditolak jaminan kesehatan saat sakit parah. Komite HAM PBB menyatakan ini membahayakan nyawanya dan melanggar perjanjian.

decisions.name: Sarbananda Sonowal v. Union of India
decisions.q: Was the special law for identifying “illegal migrants” in Assam, which put the burden of proof on the state, constitutional?
decisions.q_id: Apakah UU khusus untuk menetapkan “migran ilegal” di Assam, yang membebankan pembuktian kepada negara, konstitusional?
decisions.held: No. The Illegal Migrants (Determination by Tribunals) Act 1983 was struck down; the Foreigners Act, which puts the burden on the person to prove citizenship, applies in Assam.
decisions.plain: Assam had its own law under which the state had to prove that someone was an illegal migrant. The Supreme Court struck it down, so people now have to prove they are citizens themselves.
decisions.plain_id: Assam punya UU sendiri yang mewajibkan negara membuktikan seseorang migran ilegal. MA membatalkannya, sehingga kini orang harus membuktikan sendiri bahwa mereka warga negara.

after.en: National Register of Citizens in Assam published, leaving out about 1.9 million people.
after.id: Daftar Warga Nasional Assam diterbitkan, tidak memuat sekitar 1,9 juta orang.

decisions.name: In re Section 6A of the Citizenship Act
decisions.q: Is the rule giving citizenship to people who came to Assam from Bangladesh before 25 March 1971 constitutional?
decisions.q_id: Apakah aturan yang memberi kewarganegaraan kepada orang yang datang ke Assam dari Bangladesh sebelum 25 Maret 1971 konstitusional?
decisions.held: Yes, by four to one. Section 6A, which implements the Assam Accord, was upheld.
decisions.plain: Groups in Assam argued that the law giving citizenship to earlier migrants from Bangladesh was unconstitutional. The Supreme Court upheld the law, so those people keep their citizenship.
decisions.plain_id: Kelompok di Assam berpendapat UU yang memberi kewarganegaraan kepada migran awal dari Bangladesh inkonstitusional. MA mempertahankan UU itu, sehingga mereka tetap menjadi warga negara.

after.en: Question referred to a Constitution Bench.

decisions.name: Yap v. Thenamaris Ship’s Management
decisions.q: Does a seafarer dismissed before the end of his contract get pay for the whole unexpired term?
decisions.q_id: Apakah pelaut yang dipecat sebelum kontraknya berakhir berhak atas upah selama sisa kontrak?
decisions.held: Yes. Following Serrano, the three-month cap was unconstitutional and the seafarer was owed salary for the unexpired portion of his contract.
decisions.plain: A Filipino seafarer was let go early when his ship was sold. The Supreme Court applied its earlier Serrano ruling and said he must be paid for the rest of his contract.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang pelaut Filipina diberhentikan lebih awal ketika kapalnya dijual. MA menerapkan putusan Serrano dan menyatakan ia harus dibayar untuk sisa kontraknya.

after.en: Sameer strikes down the re-enacted cap.
after.id: Sameer membatalkan batas yang dibuat ulang.

decisions.name: People v. Lalli
decisions.q: Can recruiters who took women to Malaysia with false promises of work be convicted of trafficking and illegal recruitment?
decisions.q_id: Bisakah perekrut yang membawa perempuan ke Malaysia dengan janji kerja palsu dihukum atas perdagangan orang dan perekrutan ilegal?
decisions.held: Yes. The convictions for trafficking in persons and illegal recruitment were upheld.
decisions.plain: Women from the Philippines were promised jobs in Malaysia but were forced into prostitution. The Supreme Court upheld the recruiters’ convictions.
decisions.plain_id: Perempuan dari Filipina dijanjikan pekerjaan di Malaysia tetapi dipaksa melacur. MA menguatkan vonis terhadap para perekrut.

decisions.name: Sto. Tomas v. Salac
decisions.q: Is it constitutional to make the officers of a recruitment agency personally liable with the agency for workers’ claims?
decisions.q_id: Apakah konstitusional menjadikan pengurus agen perekrut ikut bertanggung jawab pribadi atas tuntutan pekerja?
decisions.held: Yes. Joint and several liability of corporate officers serves the state’s duty to protect overseas workers.
decisions.plain: Recruitment agencies argued it was unfair to make their directors personally pay workers’ claims. The Supreme Court said the rule is valid because it protects workers abroad.
decisions.plain_id: Agen perekrut berpendapat tidak adil membuat direkturnya membayar sendiri tuntutan pekerja. MA menyatakan aturan itu sah karena melindungi pekerja di luar negeri.

decisions.name: C v. Director of Immigration
decisions.court: Court of Final Appeal, Hong Kong
decisions.q: Must Hong Kong itself check whether a person faces persecution before removing them?
decisions.q_id: Wajibkah Hong Kong sendiri memeriksa apakah seseorang terancam penganiayaan sebelum mengeluarkannya?
decisions.held: Yes. The Director must make an independent, fair assessment of persecution claims and cannot simply rely on the UNHCR’s view.
decisions.plain: Hong Kong had left refugee claims to the UN refugee agency. The top court said the government must judge the risk itself before sending anyone away.
decisions.plain_id: Hong Kong menyerahkan klaim pengungsi kepada badan pengungsi PBB. Pengadilan tertinggi menyatakan pemerintah harus menilai sendiri risikonya sebelum mengeluarkan siapa pun.

decisions.name: Ubamaka v. Secretary for Security
decisions.court: Court of Final Appeal, Hong Kong
decisions.q: Would deporting a Nigerian man who might be prosecuted twice for the same offence breach his rights?
decisions.q_id: Apakah mendeportasi pria Nigeria yang bisa dituntut dua kali atas pelanggaran yang sama melanggar haknya?
decisions.held: No. The protection against cruel treatment is absolute and applies to removal, but the facts did not reach that level; the appeal was dismissed.
decisions.plain: A Nigerian man who had served a prison sentence in Hong Kong feared a second prosecution at home. The top court said the protection against cruel treatment applies to deportation, but not on these facts.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang pria Nigeria yang telah menjalani hukuman penjara di Hong Kong takut dituntut lagi di negaranya. Pengadilan tertinggi menyatakan perlindungan dari perlakuan kejam berlaku bagi deportasi, tetapi tidak dalam fakta ini.

decisions.name: Tsegata v. Minister of Interior (removal to a third country)
decisions.court: Supreme Court of Israel (sitting as High Court of Justice)
decisions.q: May Israel send asylum seekers to an unnamed third country in Africa, and detain those who refuse?
decisions.q_id: Bolehkah Israel mengirim pencari suaka ke negara ketiga di Afrika yang tidak disebutkan, dan menahan mereka yang menolak?
decisions.held: Removal to the third country was allowed, but people who refuse may not be detained for more than 60 days for that reason.
decisions.plain: Israel planned to send Eritrean and Sudanese asylum seekers to a third country under a secret agreement. The Supreme Court allowed it, but limited detention of those who refused to 60 days.
decisions.plain_id: Israel berencana mengirim pencari suaka Eritrea dan Sudan ke negara ketiga berdasarkan perjanjian rahasia. MA membolehkannya, tetapi membatasi penahanan bagi yang menolak menjadi 60 hari.

src.t: Supreme Court of Israel, judgments in English

decisions.name: Galon v. Attorney General (family reunification)
decisions.court: Supreme Court of Israel (sitting as High Court of Justice)
decisions.q: Is the law barring residence permits for spouses from the West Bank and Gaza constitutional?
decisions.q_id: Apakah UU yang melarang izin tinggal bagi pasangan dari Tepi Barat dan Gaza konstitusional?
decisions.held: Yes, by six to five. The temporary order was upheld on security grounds.
decisions.plain: A law stopped Israeli citizens from bringing spouses from the West Bank and Gaza to live with them. The Supreme Court, by one vote, let the law stand.
decisions.plain_id: Sebuah UU melarang warga Israel membawa pasangan dari Tepi Barat dan Gaza untuk tinggal bersama. MA, dengan selisih satu suara, mempertahankan UU itu.

src.t: Supreme Court of Israel, judgments in English

decisions.name: Abore v. Minister of Home Affairs
decisions.q: Must a detained foreigner who says he wants asylum be released to apply?
decisions.q_id: Haruskah orang asing yang ditahan dan menyatakan ingin mencari suaka dibebaskan untuk mengajukannya?
decisions.held: Yes. Once a person states an intention to seek asylum, they must be allowed to apply and may not be deported until the claim is decided.
decisions.plain: An Ethiopian man was arrested for being in South Africa without papers and said he wanted asylum. The Constitutional Court said he must be released to apply.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang pria Etiopia ditangkap karena berada di Afrika Selatan tanpa dokumen dan menyatakan ingin mencari suaka. MK menyatakan ia harus dibebaskan untuk mengajukannya.

src.t: Constitutional Court of South Africa, judgment archive
South African Legal Information Institute / LawLibrary - confirmed via official search listing (judgment)

decisions.name: Scalabrini Centre v. Minister of Home Affairs (abandonment rules)
decisions.q: May an asylum claim be treated as abandoned just because the permit was not renewed in time?
decisions.q_id: Bolehkah permohonan suaka dianggap ditinggalkan hanya karena izinnya tidak diperpanjang tepat waktu?
decisions.held: No. The abandonment provisions of the Refugees Act breached the right against return to danger and were struck down.
decisions.plain: A 2020 change in South Africa’s law said that asylum seekers who missed a renewal date had abandoned their claim and could be deported. The Constitutional Court struck this down.
decisions.plain_id: Perubahan UU Afrika Selatan pada 2020 menyatakan pencari suaka yang terlambat memperpanjang izin dianggap meninggalkan permohonannya dan bisa dideportasi. MK membatalkannya.

src.t: Constitutional Court of South Africa, judgment archive

decisions.name: Helen Suzman Foundation v. Minister of Home Affairs (Zimbabwean Exemption Permits)
decisions.court: High Court of South Africa, Gauteng Division
decisions.q: Could the Minister end the permits of about 178,000 Zimbabweans without consulting them?
decisions.q_id: Bisakah Menteri mengakhiri izin sekitar 178.000 warga Zimbabwe tanpa berkonsultasi dengan mereka?
decisions.held: No. The decision was set aside because there was no fair process, and the permits stayed valid until the Minister decided again after consultation.
decisions.plain: Many Zimbabweans had lived and worked in South Africa for over ten years on special permits. The government decided to end them. The High Court said this was unlawful without a fair process.
decisions.plain_id: Banyak warga Zimbabwe tinggal dan bekerja di Afrika Selatan lebih dari sepuluh tahun dengan izin khusus. Pemerintah memutuskan mengakhirinya. Pengadilan Tinggi menyatakan ini tidak sah tanpa proses yang adil.

decisions.name: Bula v. Minister of Home Affairs
decisions.court: Supreme Court of Appeal, South Africa
decisions.q: May foreigners who say they want asylum be held for deportation without being allowed to apply?
decisions.q_id: Bolehkah orang asing yang menyatakan ingin mencari suaka ditahan untuk dideportasi tanpa diizinkan mengajukan?
decisions.held: No. Once they indicate an intention to apply, they are entitled to be released and to get an asylum seeker permit.
decisions.plain: Ethiopian men held in a deportation centre said they wanted asylum. The appeal court said they must be released and allowed to apply.
decisions.plain_id: Pria Etiopia yang ditahan di pusat deportasi menyatakan ingin mencari suaka. Pengadilan banding menyatakan mereka harus dibebaskan dan diizinkan mengajukan.

src.t: South African Legal Information Institute / LawLibrary - confirmed via official search listing (judgment)

decisions.name: Coalition for Reform and Democracy v. Republic of Kenya
decisions.q: Can a law cap the number of refugees in Kenya at 150,000?
decisions.q_id: Bisakah UU membatasi jumlah pengungsi di Kenya maksimal 150.000?
decisions.held: No. The cap would force the return of refugees and was struck down with other parts of the security law.
decisions.plain: A security law said Kenya could host no more than 150,000 refugees, when far more already lived there. A five-judge bench of the High Court struck the cap down.
decisions.plain_id: UU keamanan menyatakan Kenya hanya boleh menampung paling banyak 150.000 pengungsi, padahal jauh lebih banyak yang sudah tinggal di sana. Majelis lima hakim Pengadilan Tinggi membatalkan batas itu.

decisions.name: Good v. Attorney General
decisions.q: Can the President declare a foreigner a prohibited immigrant without giving reasons or a hearing?
decisions.q_id: Bisakah Presiden menyatakan orang asing sebagai imigran terlarang tanpa alasan atau sidang?
decisions.held: Yes. The court upheld the President’s power and held it was not open to review by the courts.
decisions.plain: A foreign professor was expelled from Botswana after writing an article critical of the government. The highest court said the President could do this without explaining why. The African Commission later disagreed.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang dosen asing diusir dari Botswana setelah menulis artikel yang mengkritik pemerintah. Pengadilan tertinggi menyatakan Presiden boleh melakukannya tanpa menjelaskan alasan. Komisi Afrika kemudian berpendapat lain.

decisions.name: Modise v. Botswana
decisions.court: African Commission on Human and Peoples’ Rights
decisions.q: Did Botswana breach the rights of a man it refused to recognise as a citizen and repeatedly deported?
decisions.q_id: Apakah Botswana melanggar hak seorang pria yang tidak diakui sebagai warga negara dan berulang kali dideportasi?
decisions.held: Yes. Denying him citizenship and deporting him to South Africa and a homeland breached his rights to equal protection, dignity and family life.
decisions.plain: A politician in Botswana was told he was not a citizen and was sent to South Africa several times, ending up in a homeland area with no status. The African Commission said Botswana had broken the Charter.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang politisi di Botswana dinyatakan bukan warga negara dan beberapa kali dikirim ke Afrika Selatan, hingga terdampar di wilayah homeland tanpa status. Komisi Afrika menyatakan Botswana melanggar Piagam.

after.en: He is given a form of citizenship; the Commission notes it is not by birth. [Check.]
after.id: Ia diberi bentuk kewarganegaraan; Komisi mencatat itu bukan kewarganegaraan sejak lahir. [Periksa.]

decisions.name: Malawi African Association and others v. Mauritania
decisions.court: African Commission on Human and Peoples’ Rights
decisions.q: Was Mauritania responsible for expelling black Mauritanians to Senegal and Mali and taking their papers?
decisions.q_id: Apakah Mauritania bertanggung jawab atas pengusiran warga Mauritania kulit hitam ke Senegal dan Mali serta perampasan dokumen mereka?
decisions.held: Yes. The expulsions, the destruction of identity papers and related abuses were serious violations; the state was asked to allow return and restore documents.
decisions.plain: In 1989–1991 tens of thousands of black Mauritanians were driven into Senegal and Mali and their papers destroyed. The African Commission found grave violations and asked Mauritania to let them return.
decisions.plain_id: Pada 1989–1991 puluhan ribu warga Mauritania kulit hitam diusir ke Senegal dan Mali dan dokumen mereka dihancurkan. Komisi Afrika menemukan pelanggaran berat dan meminta Mauritania mengizinkan mereka pulang.

after.en: Organised returns from Senegal begin with UNHCR. [Check.]
after.id: Pemulangan terorganisasi dari Senegal dimulai bersama UNHCR. [Periksa.]

decisions.name: Workers’ wage claims against Saudi Oger
decisions.q: Can workers enforce labour judgments for unpaid wages against a large construction company in financial difficulty?
decisions.q_id: Bisakah pekerja menegakkan putusan upah yang belum dibayar terhadap perusahaan konstruksi besar yang sedang kesulitan keuangan?
decisions.held: As reported, the court ordered the company to pay the delayed wages, gave it the grace period allowed by the rules, and began steps to attach its assets.
decisions.plain: Tens of thousands of workers of many nationalities at Saudi Oger went months without pay. Labour judgments in their favour were sent to the execution court, which ordered payment and moved to seize company assets.
decisions.plain_id: Puluhan ribu pekerja berbagai kebangsaan di Saudi Oger tidak digaji berbulan-bulan. Putusan perburuhan yang memenangkan mereka dikirim ke pengadilan eksekusi, yang memerintahkan pembayaran dan mulai menyita aset perusahaan.

after.en: Wage delays; many workers return home with claims pending.
after.id: Upah tertunda; banyak pekerja pulang dengan tuntutan yang belum selesai.

after.en: The court estimates about SAR 2.6 billion owed. [Check.]
after.id: Pengadilan memperkirakan utang sekitar SAR 2,6 miliar. [Periksa.]

after.en: A repayment scheme begins; some former workers receive cheques.
after.id: Skema pembayaran dimulai; sebagian mantan pekerja menerima cek.

decisions.name: Domestic worker’s claim for years of unpaid wages
decisions.q: Can a domestic worker who was not paid for many years recover her wages through the courts?
decisions.q_id: Bisakah pekerja rumah tangga yang tidak digaji bertahun-tahun mendapatkan upahnya melalui pengadilan?
decisions.held: As reported, the court ordered the employer to pay about SAR 68,000 in back wages and her ticket home; the employer appealed. [Check amount and years.]
decisions.plain: A Sri Lankan domestic worker said she had not been paid for over a decade. A court in Hail ordered the employer to pay her wages and her flight home.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang pekerja rumah tangga asal Sri Lanka mengaku tidak digaji lebih dari sepuluh tahun. Pengadilan di Hail memerintahkan majikan membayar upahnya dan tiket pulangnya.

decisions.name: Staff wage claims against a contracting company owner
decisions.q: Can a labour court compel a company owner personally to pay staff wages that are months overdue?
decisions.q_id: Bisakah pengadilan perburuhan memaksa pemilik perusahaan secara pribadi membayar upah staf yang tertunggak berbulan-bulan?
decisions.held: As reported, the court said it would issue an arrest warrant against the owner if the wages were not paid.
decisions.plain: Workers of a contracting company had not been paid for months. A labour court told the owner to pay them or face arrest.
decisions.plain_id: Pekerja sebuah perusahaan kontraktor tidak digaji berbulan-bulan. Pengadilan perburuhan memerintahkan pemiliknya membayar atau menghadapi penangkapan.

decisions.name: Employer stopped paying salary without formally ending the contract
decisions.court: Abu Dhabi Court of Cassation (as reported)
decisions.q: If an employer simply stops paying salary, does the employment end?
decisions.q_id: Jika majikan berhenti membayar gaji begitu saja, apakah hubungan kerja berakhir?
decisions.held: No, as reported. With no document showing the employee had been told of termination, the contract continued and wages were owed for the whole period, with gratuity and leave pay.
decisions.plain: A company stopped paying an employee from mid-2025 but never told her in writing that her job had ended. The court said she was still employed and ordered the company to pay her wages, gratuity and leave.
decisions.plain_id: Sebuah perusahaan berhenti menggaji karyawan sejak pertengahan 2025 tetapi tidak pernah memberi tahu secara tertulis bahwa pekerjaannya berakhir. Pengadilan menyatakan ia masih bekerja dan memerintahkan perusahaan membayar gaji, pesangon, dan cuti.

decisions.name: Waiver of end-of-service benefits signed during employment
decisions.q: Is a waiver of end-of-service benefits signed before the job ends binding?
decisions.q_id: Apakah pernyataan melepaskan pesangon yang ditandatangani sebelum pekerjaan berakhir mengikat?
decisions.held: No, as reported. A waiver or settlement of end-of-service rights made before the employment ends is void under Federal Decree-Law No. 33 of 2021.
decisions.plain: An employee had signed a paper giving up end-of-service pay while still working. The court said such a waiver does not count and ordered the benefits paid.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang karyawan menandatangani surat melepaskan pesangon saat masih bekerja. Pengadilan menyatakan pelepasan itu tidak berlaku dan memerintahkan pesangon dibayar.

after.en: Judgment reported. [Check court level and date.]
after.id: Putusan dilaporkan. [Periksa tingkat pengadilan dan tanggal.]

decisions.name: Gratuity before one year of service
decisions.q: Is a worker who leaves before completing one year of service entitled to end-of-service gratuity?
decisions.q_id: Apakah pekerja yang berhenti sebelum genap setahun bekerja berhak atas pesangon?
decisions.held: No, as reported: under the 1980 Labour Law a full year of continuous service was required.
decisions.plain: A worker who left before a year asked for end-of-service pay. The court said the law then in force required a full year. The 2021 law keeps a one-year threshold. [Check.]
decisions.plain_id: Seorang pekerja yang berhenti sebelum setahun meminta pesangon. Pengadilan menyatakan UU yang berlaku saat itu mensyaratkan setahun penuh. UU 2021 tetap memakai batas satu tahun. [Periksa.]

decisions.name: Hamton International workers’ wage claims
decisions.court: Labour Dispute Settlement Committee, Qatar (as reported)
decisions.q: Can the new labour dispute committees secure unpaid wages for workers of a company that stopped paying?
decisions.q_id: Bisakah komite sengketa perburuhan yang baru menjamin upah yang belum dibayar bagi pekerja perusahaan yang berhenti menggaji?
decisions.held: The committee ruled in the workers’ favour and ordered payment; as of September 2019 the company had not paid, and many workers settled for less or went home.
decisions.plain: Workers of a construction company in Qatar were not paid for months. About 100 who stayed won their cases at the new labour committees, but reports say the money had not been paid months later.
decisions.plain_id: Pekerja sebuah perusahaan konstruksi di Qatar tidak digaji berbulan-bulan. Sekitar 100 orang yang bertahan memenangkan perkara di komite perburuhan yang baru, tetapi menurut laporan uangnya belum dibayar berbulan-bulan kemudian.

after.en: Labour Dispute Settlement Committees start work.
after.id: Komite Penyelesaian Sengketa Perburuhan mulai bekerja.

after.en: Workers’ Support and Insurance Fund begins paying some awards. [Check.]
after.id: Dana Dukungan dan Asuransi Pekerja mulai membayar sebagian putusan. [Periksa.]

src.t: Business & Human Rights Resource Centre summary

decisions.name: Recruitment offices’ challenge to the Domestic Workers Law
decisions.q: Are the provisions making recruitment offices bear return costs and refunds under Law 68/2015 constitutional?
decisions.q_id: Apakah ketentuan yang mewajibkan kantor perekrut menanggung biaya pemulangan dan pengembalian dana dalam UU 68/2015 konstitusional?
decisions.held: Yes, as reported. The court rejected the petition of ten recruitment offices against Articles 17 and 51.
decisions.plain: Ten domestic worker recruitment offices said the law was unfair to them because it made them send workers home and repay employers in some cases. The Constitutional Court rejected their challenge.
decisions.plain_id: Sepuluh kantor perekrut pekerja rumah tangga berpendapat UU tidak adil karena mewajibkan mereka memulangkan pekerja dan mengembalikan uang majikan dalam kasus tertentu. MK menolak gugatan mereka.

after.id: UU Pekerja Rumah Tangga No. 68 Tahun 2015.

decisions.name: Qualifications for owners of domestic worker offices
decisions.q: May the law require owners of recruitment offices to hold a secondary school certificate and have no disabling physical condition?
decisions.q_id: Bolehkah UU mensyaratkan pemilik kantor perekrut berijazah sekolah menengah dan tidak memiliki kondisi fisik yang menghalangi?
decisions.held: No, as reported. The court struck down the third clause of Article 2 setting these conditions.
decisions.plain: Kuwait’s new domestic workers law set education and health conditions for people who own recruitment offices. The Constitutional Court struck down that clause. The case concerns office owners, not workers, but shapes how recruitment is regulated.
decisions.plain_id: UU pekerja rumah tangga Kuwait yang baru menetapkan syarat pendidikan dan kesehatan bagi pemilik kantor perekrut. MK membatalkan klausul itu. Perkara ini menyangkut pemilik kantor, bukan pekerja, tetapi memengaruhi cara perekrutan diatur.

decisions.name: Al Sawadi Resort workers’ wage claims
decisions.q: Can workers left without pay when their resort closed recover their wages through the courts?
decisions.q_id: Bisakah pekerja yang tidak digaji ketika resor tempat mereka bekerja tutup mendapatkan upahnya melalui pengadilan?
decisions.held: As reported, 59 of the 73 stranded workers won judgments for unpaid basic pay; the rest awaited a final ruling.
decisions.plain: A resort in Oman closed and 73 workers were left stranded without wages. Most of them won their court cases for unpaid pay.
decisions.plain_id: Sebuah resor di Oman tutup dan 73 pekerja terlantar tanpa upah. Sebagian besar memenangkan perkara mereka di pengadilan atas upah yang belum dibayar.

decisions.name: Undocumented worker and industrial accident compensation
decisions.q: Is a foreign worker without a work visa covered by industrial accident compensation insurance?
decisions.q_id: Apakah pekerja asing tanpa visa kerja dilindungi asuransi kompensasi kecelakaan kerja?
decisions.held: Yes. A contract with a worker who lacks work authorisation is not void for that reason, and the injured worker is a “worker” entitled to benefits.
decisions.plain: A foreign worker without the right papers was hurt at a factory in Korea and refused compensation. The Supreme Court said immigration status does not cancel his right to accident benefits.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang pekerja asing tanpa dokumen yang sah terluka di sebuah pabrik di Korea dan ditolak kompensasinya. MA menyatakan status imigrasi tidak menghapus haknya atas tunjangan kecelakaan.

decisions.name: Deportation right after an asylum refusal (Sri Lankan nationals)
decisions.q: May the state deport asylum seekers the day after telling them their objection was rejected, before they can go to court?
decisions.q_id: Bolehkah negara mendeportasi pencari suaka sehari setelah memberi tahu keberatannya ditolak, sebelum mereka bisa ke pengadilan?
decisions.held: No. Removing them so quickly deprived them of the opportunity to sue and violated the constitutional right of access to the courts; damages were awarded.
decisions.plain: Two Sri Lankan men were told their asylum objection had failed and were put on a plane the next day. The Tokyo High Court said this denied them their right to go to court.
decisions.plain_id: Dua pria Sri Lanka diberi tahu keberatan suaka mereka gagal dan diterbangkan keesokan harinya. Pengadilan Tinggi Tokyo menyatakan ini menghilangkan hak mereka untuk ke pengadilan.

decisions.name: Death of a Cameroonian man in immigration detention (Ushiku)
decisions.q: Is the state liable for the death of a detainee whose calls for help were not answered with medical care?
decisions.q_id: Apakah negara bertanggung jawab atas kematian tahanan yang permintaan tolongnya tidak dijawab dengan perawatan medis?
decisions.held: Yes, in part. Staff should have called an ambulance when his condition worsened; damages were awarded, though a link between the failure and the death was not found. [Check.]
decisions.plain: A man from Cameroon died in 2014 in an immigration detention centre in Ushiku after crying out in pain through the night. The court said staff failed to get him to hospital and awarded damages to his family.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang pria dari Kamerun meninggal pada 2014 di pusat detensi imigrasi Ushiku setelah semalaman mengerang kesakitan. Pengadilan menyatakan petugas lalai membawanya ke rumah sakit dan memberi ganti rugi kepada keluarganya.

decisions.name: J.Y. Interpretation No. 497 (entry and residence of people from mainland China)
decisions.q: May rules issued under the cross-strait statute restrict entry and residence of people from mainland China?
decisions.q_id: Bolehkah aturan berdasarkan UU lintas selat membatasi masuk dan tinggalnya warga Tiongkok daratan?
decisions.held: Yes. The restrictions were authorised by statute and did not breach freedom of residence and movement.
decisions.plain: Taiwan limited how people from mainland China could come and stay. The Constitutional Court said these limits were allowed.
decisions.plain_id: Taiwan membatasi cara warga Tiongkok daratan datang dan tinggal. MK menyatakan pembatasan itu boleh.

decisions.name: J.Y. Interpretation No. 618 (former mainland spouses and public office)
decisions.q: May people from mainland China who settled in Taiwan be barred from public office for ten years after registration?
decisions.q_id: Bolehkah warga asal Tiongkok daratan yang menetap di Taiwan dilarang menjadi pegawai negeri selama sepuluh tahun setelah terdaftar?
