decisions.name: Decision 028-029/PUU-IV/2006 (minimum age of 21 for work with private employers abroad)
decisions.q: Does the rule that workers placed with individual (household) employers abroad must be at least 21 breach the right to work and equal treatment?
decisions.q_id: Apakah ketentuan bahwa TKI yang dipekerjakan pada pengguna perseorangan sekurang-kurangnya berusia 21 tahun melanggar hak atas pekerjaan dan perlakuan yang sama?
decisions.held: Rejected (5 to 4). The age limit in Art. 35(a) of Law 39/2004 pursues a legitimate aim, the personal and emotional maturity needed for work in private homes, is objectively and reasonably justified and is not discriminatory.
decisions.plain: Women aged 18 to 20 were refused departure because they were under 21, the minimum age for working in a private household abroad. They asked the Constitutional Court to strike the rule down. A narrow majority refused: the Court said the age limit protects workers and does not stop anyone from working.
decisions.plain_id: Sejumlah perempuan berusia 18 sampai 20 tahun ditolak berangkat karena belum berusia 21 tahun, batas usia minimum untuk bekerja pada pengguna perseorangan di luar negeri. Mereka meminta Mahkamah Konstitusi membatalkan ketentuan tersebut. Mayoritas tipis hakim menolak: menurut Mahkamah, batas usia tersebut melindungi pekerja dan tidak menghalangi hak seseorang untuk bekerja.

after.en: Petition rejected; the age limit of 21 stays.
after.id: Permohonan ditolak; batas usia 21 tahun tetap berlaku.

decisions.name: Decision 5/PUU-XI/2013 (challenge to Law 39/2004, Art. 60, by a former worker's brother)
decisions.q: Could the brother of a former migrant worker challenge Art. 60 of Law 39/2004 on her behalf?
decisions.q_id: Apakah saudara laki-laki seorang mantan TKI dapat menguji Pasal 60 UU 39/2004 atas nama saudaranya?
decisions.held: Not accepted. The petitioner gave no proof that he was the guardian of the worker concerned, so he lacked legal standing.
decisions.plain: A man asked the Court to review a rule of the 2004 migrant worker law on behalf of his sister, a former migrant worker. The Court did not look at the rule itself, because he could not show he had the right to act for her.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang laki-laki meminta Mahkamah menguji salah satu ketentuan UU 39/2004 atas nama saudara perempuannya, seorang mantan TKI. Mahkamah tidak memeriksa pokok perkara karena Pemohon tidak dapat membuktikan bahwa ia berhak bertindak atas nama saudaranya.

after.en: Petition not accepted for lack of standing.
after.id: Permohonan tidak dapat diterima karena Pemohon tidak memiliki kedudukan hukum.

decisions.name: Decision 50/PUU-XI/2013 (renewing a contract without first going home)
decisions.q: May the law require a worker employed by an individual employer abroad to return to Indonesia before renewing the contract (Law 39/2004, Art. 59)?
decisions.q_id: Bolehkah undang-undang mewajibkan TKI yang bekerja pada pengguna perseorangan pulang ke Indonesia sebelum memperpanjang perjanjian kerja (Pasal 59 UU 39/2004)?
decisions.held: Granted in part. Art. 59 was struck down: it removed or threatened the worker's chance to extend a contract with an employer of the worker's choice, breaching equal treatment and the right to work and a decent living. The other challenged articles (Arts. 10(b), 58(2), 60) were upheld; who may place workers abroad is a matter of legislative policy.
decisions.plain: Women domestic workers from Cianjur challenged a rule forcing workers with household employers to come home before they could renew their contract. The Court struck the rule down: a protection law should not take away a worker's chance to stay with an employer she wants to keep working for.
decisions.plain_id: Para pekerja rumah tangga migran perempuan dari Cianjur menguji ketentuan yang mewajibkan TKI pada pengguna perseorangan pulang terlebih dahulu sebelum memperpanjang perjanjian kerja. Mahkamah membatalkan ketentuan tersebut: undang-undang perlindungan tidak boleh menghilangkan kesempatan pekerja untuk tetap bekerja pada majikan yang dikehendakinya.

after.en: Art. 59 of Law 39/2004 struck down; the other articles stay. Law 39/2004 was later replaced by Law 18/2017.
after.id: Pasal 59 UU 39/2004 dinyatakan bertentangan dengan UUD 1945; pasal lainnya tetap berlaku. UU 39/2004 kemudian diganti dengan UU 18/2017.

decisions.name: Decision 61/PUU-XIII/2015 (placement rules behind the Middle East moratorium)
decisions.q: Do the placement rules of Law 39/2004 (Arts. 11(1), 27(1), 81(1), 94 and 95), relied on to stop placements in the Middle East, discriminate against workers and placement companies?
decisions.q_id: Apakah ketentuan penempatan dalam UU 39/2004 (Pasal 11 ayat (1), 27 ayat (1), 81 ayat (1), 94 dan 95), yang menjadi dasar penghentian penempatan ke Timur Tengah, mendiskriminasi pekerja dan perusahaan penempatan?
decisions.held: Rejected. Different treatment serves to uphold citizens' rights to work and a decent living rather than to discriminate; requiring employers to be legal entities makes them easier to hold liable; the placement agency BNP2TKI is an open legal policy choice of the legislature.
decisions.plain: A placement company, a former worker in Riyadh and a woman who could not leave because of the halt on placements to the Middle East challenged the rules behind it. The Court upheld them, saying the rules aim to protect workers.
decisions.plain_id: Sebuah perusahaan penempatan, seorang mantan TKI di Riyadh, dan seorang calon TKI yang tidak dapat berangkat karena penghentian penempatan ke Timur Tengah menguji ketentuan yang menjadi dasarnya. Mahkamah menolak permohonan tersebut karena ketentuan itu bertujuan melindungi pekerja.

decisions.name: Decision 6/PUU-XIII/2015 (overseas worker card (KTKLN) for seafarers)
decisions.q: Is it unconstitutional to require Indonesian seafarers, like other workers going abroad, to hold the overseas worker card (KTKLN) (Law 39/2004, Arts. 26(2)(f) and 28)?
decisions.q_id: Apakah kewajiban pelaut Indonesia, seperti TKI lainnya, untuk memiliki Kartu Tenaga Kerja Luar Negeri (KTKLN) (Pasal 26 ayat (2) huruf f dan Pasal 28 UU 39/2004) bertentangan dengan UUD 1945?
decisions.held: Rejected. The KTKLN is a form of state protection at every stage of placement abroad: before, during and after placement.
decisions.plain: Six seafarers argued that the card required of workers going abroad was a burden that did not fit their work. The Court disagreed: the card is one of the ways the state protects workers before, during and after work abroad.
decisions.plain_id: Enam orang pelaut berpendapat bahwa kartu yang diwajibkan bagi TKI merupakan beban yang tidak sesuai dengan pekerjaan mereka. Mahkamah tidak sependapat: kartu tersebut merupakan salah satu bentuk perlindungan negara sebelum, selama, dan sesudah bekerja di luar negeri.

after.en: Petition rejected; the KTKLN rule stays.
after.id: Permohonan ditolak; ketentuan KTKLN tetap berlaku.

decisions.name: Decision 12/PUU-XIV/2016 (settling disputes between workers and placement companies)
decisions.q: Does Art. 85(2) of Law 39/2004 on settling disputes between a worker and the placement company deny workers access to justice because it does not list every remedy?
decisions.q_id: Apakah Pasal 85 ayat (2) UU 39/2004 tentang penyelesaian perselisihan antara TKI dan PPTKIS menghalangi akses pekerja terhadap keadilan karena tidak menyebutkan semua upaya hukum?
decisions.held: Rejected. Leaving a remedy out of Art. 85(2) does not make it unconstitutional; if workers do not get access to justice, that is a problem of implementation, not of the norm.
decisions.plain: The head of a union of Indonesian overseas workers said the law's dispute rules left workers without a way to court against their placement company. The Court said the rule itself is valid and that any failure lies in how it is applied.
decisions.plain_id: Ketua serikat pekerja Indonesia luar negeri berpendapat bahwa ketentuan penyelesaian perselisihan dalam undang-undang membuat pekerja tidak memiliki jalan ke pengadilan untuk menggugat perusahaan penempatan. Mahkamah menyatakan ketentuan tersebut sah dan bahwa kekurangannya terletak pada pelaksanaannya.

decisions.name: Decision 32/PUU-XV/2017 (meaning of 'exploitation' in the trafficking law)
decisions.q: Is the trafficking offence in Art. 2(1) of Law 21/2007 unclear because it does not require proof that the victim was actually exploited?
decisions.q_id: Apakah tindak pidana perdagangan orang dalam Pasal 2 ayat (1) UU 21/2007 tidak jelas karena tidak mensyaratkan bukti bahwa korban benar-benar dieksploitasi?
decisions.held: Rejected. Art. 2(1) defines a formal offence, clear on its face; the petitioner's case concerns the application of the law and proof, not its constitutionality.
decisions.plain: A man prosecuted under the anti-trafficking law argued that it was unfair to convict without proof of actual exploitation. The Court said the law is clear: the crime is complete when the acts are done for the purpose of exploitation, and his complaint was about the evidence in his own case.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang laki-laki yang dituntut berdasarkan UU TPPO berpendapat bahwa tidak adil menghukum seseorang tanpa bukti eksploitasi yang nyata. Mahkamah menyatakan undang-undang tersebut jelas: tindak pidana telah selesai ketika perbuatan dilakukan dengan tujuan eksploitasi, dan keberatan Pemohon menyangkut pembuktian dalam perkaranya sendiri.

after.id: Permohonan ditolak; Pasal 2 ayat (1) tetap berlaku.

decisions.name: Decision 83/PUU-XVII/2019 (capital and deposit rules for placement companies)
decisions.q: Do the minimum paid-up capital (Rp5 billion) and bank deposit (Rp1.5 billion) required of placement companies under Law 18/2017, with criminal penalties, breach the Constitution?
decisions.q_id: Apakah kewajiban modal disetor (Rp5 miliar) dan deposito (Rp1,5 miliar) bagi P3MI dalam UU 18/2017, beserta ketentuan pidananya, bertentangan dengan UUD 1945?
decisions.held: Rejected (5 to 4). Raising the capital and deposit is part of ensuring the qualifications and credibility of placement companies; the criminal provisions apply to anyone who breaches the rules.
decisions.plain: The association of placement companies said the high capital and deposit rules of the 2017 law shut small agencies out. A narrow majority upheld the rules, which help make sure agencies can answer for what happens to the workers they send.
decisions.plain_id: Asosiasi perusahaan penempatan berpendapat bahwa kewajiban modal dan deposito yang tinggi dalam UU 18/2017 menyingkirkan perusahaan kecil. Mayoritas tipis hakim mempertahankan ketentuan tersebut, yang membantu memastikan perusahaan penempatan dapat bertanggung jawab atas pekerja yang dikirimnya.

after.en: Petition rejected; the capital and deposit rules stay.
after.id: Permohonan ditolak; ketentuan modal dan deposito tetap berlaku.

decisions.name: Decision 20/PUU-XVIII/2020 (bank deposit required of placement companies)
decisions.q: Does the Rp1.5 billion deposit in a state bank required of placement companies (Law 18/2017, Art. 54(1)(b)) breach the Constitution?
decisions.q_id: Apakah kewajiban deposito Rp1,5 miliar di bank pemerintah bagi P3MI (Pasal 54 ayat (1) huruf b UU 18/2017) bertentangan dengan UUD 1945?
decisions.held: Rejected as to Art. 54(1)(b), following decision 83/PUU-XVII/2019; not accepted as to Art. 5(d), which sets duties of migrant workers, not of companies, so the company directors lacked standing.
decisions.plain: Directors of two placement companies challenged the bank deposit rule. The Court kept it, as it had in a decision the same day.
decisions.plain_id: Direktur dua perusahaan penempatan menguji ketentuan deposito di bank. Mahkamah mempertahankannya, sebagaimana dalam putusan yang diucapkan pada hari yang sama.

after.en: Petition rejected in part and not accepted in part.
after.id: Permohonan ditolak sebagian dan tidak dapat diterima sebagian.

decisions.name: Decision 40/PUU-IX/2011 (exit ban during a preliminary investigation)
decisions.q: May the immigration law let officials stop a person from leaving Indonesia while a matter is only at the preliminary investigation stage (Law 6/2011, Art. 16(1)(b))?
decisions.q_id: Bolehkah UU Keimigrasian memungkinkan pejabat mencegah seseorang keluar wilayah Indonesia ketika perkara masih dalam tahap penyelidikan (Pasal 16 ayat (1) huruf b UU 6/2011)?
decisions.held: Granted. The words 'penyelidikan dan' were struck down: refusing exit when a person is not yet even a suspect can easily be used to block travel abroad and breaches legal certainty and equal treatment (Art. 28D(1)).
decisions.plain: Six advocates challenged the power to stop people leaving the country before they are even suspects. The Court agreed and removed it, so a ban on leaving now needs at least a formal criminal investigation.
decisions.plain_id: Enam advokat menguji kewenangan mencegah orang keluar negeri sebelum ia ditetapkan sebagai tersangka. Mahkamah mengabulkan permohonan tersebut sehingga pencegahan ke luar negeri kini sekurang-kurangnya memerlukan tahap penyidikan.

after.en: Words 'penyelidikan dan' in Art. 16(1)(b) struck down.
after.id: Kata “penyelidikan dan” dalam Pasal 16 ayat (1) huruf b dinyatakan bertentangan dengan UUD 1945.

decisions.name: Decision 64/PUU-IX/2011 (repeated extension of exit bans)
decisions.q: May an exit ban under the immigration law be extended by six months 'each time' without limit (Law 6/2011, Art. 97(1))?
decisions.q_id: Bolehkah pencegahan ke luar negeri berdasarkan UU Keimigrasian diperpanjang enam bulan “setiap kali” tanpa batas (Pasal 97 ayat (1) UU 6/2011)?
decisions.held: Granted in part. The phrase 'setiap kali' (each time) is unconstitutional; extensions are acceptable only if limited and based on justice and legal certainty.
decisions.plain: A law professor under a travel ban challenged the rule that let the ban be renewed again and again. The Court removed the words 'each time', so renewals now have a limit.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang guru besar yang dicegah ke luar negeri menguji ketentuan yang memungkinkan pencegahan diperpanjang berkali-kali. Mahkamah membatalkan frasa “setiap kali” sehingga perpanjangan kini dibatasi.

after.en: Phrase 'setiap kali' in Art. 97(1) struck down.
after.id: Frasa “setiap kali” dalam Pasal 97 ayat (1) dinyatakan bertentangan dengan UUD 1945.

decisions.name: Ma Thida v. Union of Myanmar (overseas employment charge or trafficking charge)
decisions.cite: Criminal Revision No. 82(b) of 2020 and No. 1(ka) of 2020, Myanmar Law Reports (Rulings) 2021, pp. 50-53
decisions.q: Should a charge under the Overseas Employment Law (s. 26) be replaced by a heavier charge under the Anti Trafficking in Persons Law?
decisions.q_id: Apakah dakwaan berdasarkan Undang-Undang Pekerjaan di Luar Negeri (Pasal 26) harus diganti dengan dakwaan yang lebih berat berdasarkan Undang-Undang Anti Perdagangan Orang?
decisions.plain: The High Court ordered a recruitment case to be re-charged under the anti-trafficking law, which carries heavier penalties. On revision, the Supreme Court held that a charge properly framed by the trial court should not be set aside just to frame a heavier one. Read from the Burmese report; to be confirmed by a Burmese reader.
decisions.plain_id: Pengadilan Tinggi memerintahkan agar perkara perekrutan didakwa ulang berdasarkan undang-undang anti perdagangan orang yang ancaman pidananya lebih berat. Dalam pemeriksaan revisi, Mahkamah Agung menyatakan bahwa dakwaan yang telah disusun dengan benar oleh pengadilan tingkat pertama tidak boleh dikesampingkan hanya untuk menyusun dakwaan yang lebih berat. Dibaca dari laporan berbahasa Myanmar; perlu dikonfirmasi oleh pembaca bahasa Myanmar.

src.t: Union Supreme Court, Myanmar Law Reports (Rulings) 2021

args.en: Labour rights apply whatever a worker’s immigration status
args.id: Hak pekerja berlaku apa pun status imigrasinya

args.en: Treating migrant workers worse than others breaches equality
args.id: Memperlakukan pekerja migran lebih buruk melanggar kesetaraan

args.en: Tying a worker to one employer breaches liberty or freedom of occupation
args.id: Mengikat pekerja pada satu majikan melanggar kebebasan

args.en: The state must make forced labour and servitude crimes and enforce them
args.id: Negara wajib menjadikan kerja paksa dan perhambaan tindak pidana dan menegakkannya

args.en: The state must investigate trafficking and protect possible victims
args.id: Negara wajib menyelidiki perdagangan orang dan melindungi calon korban

args.en: Illegal working does not bar a claim against an abusive employer
args.id: Bekerja secara ilegal tidak menghalangi gugatan terhadap majikan yang menyalahgunakan

args.en: The recruiter at home is liable together with the employer abroad
args.id: Agen perekrut di dalam negeri ikut bertanggung jawab bersama majikan di luar negeri

args.en: A rule struck down as unconstitutional cannot simply be re-enacted
args.id: Aturan yang sudah dibatalkan tidak bisa begitu saja dibuat lagi

args.en: Protection laws must keep covering seafarers and fishers
args.id: UU pelindungan harus tetap mencakup awak kapal dan pelaut perikanan

args.en: The state must secure food and registration for migrant workers in a crisis
args.id: Negara wajib menjamin pangan dan pendataan pekerja migran saat krisis

args.en: A compulsory live-in rule is unlawful
args.id: Aturan wajib tinggal bersama majikan tidak sah

args.en: Discrimination because of immigration status is race or nationality discrimination
args.id: Diskriminasi karena status imigrasi adalah diskriminasi ras atau kewarganegaraan

args.en: Arrested foreign nationals must be told they can contact their consulate
args.id: Warga asing yang ditangkap wajib diberi tahu hak menghubungi konsulat

args.en: Irregular entry or stay must not be punished with prison
args.id: Masuk atau tinggal tanpa dokumen tidak boleh dihukum penjara

args.en: Migrants may not be expelled as a group without individual review
args.id: Migran tidak boleh diusir berkelompok tanpa pemeriksaan perorangan

args.en: Children born in the country must not be left stateless because of their parents’ status
args.id: Anak yang lahir di negara itu tidak boleh dibiarkan tanpa kewarganegaraan karena status orang tuanya

args.en: Migrants are entitled at least to emergency health care
args.id: Migran berhak setidaknya atas layanan kesehatan darurat

args.en: Restricting women’s migration breaches equality
args.id: Membatasi migrasi perempuan melanggar kesetaraan

args.en: Accusations made after a dispute with the employer must be examined for motive
args.id: Tuduhan yang muncul setelah sengketa dengan majikan harus diperiksa motifnya

args.en: Immigration detention must have a time limit and prompt review by a court
args.id: Penahanan imigrasi harus punya batas waktu dan segera ditinjau pengadilan

args.en: A worker’s lawful speech or activism must not cost them their stay or freedom
args.id: Pendapat atau kegiatan sah pekerja tidak boleh membuatnya kehilangan izin tinggal atau kebebasan

args.en: People waiting for protection decisions have a right to work
args.id: Orang yang menunggu keputusan perlindungan berhak bekerja

args.en: Migrant parents may stay to care for children who are residents
args.id: Orang tua migran boleh tinggal untuk merawat anak yang berstatus penduduk

args.en: Pregnancy or childbirth must not cost a migrant worker her job or permit
args.id: Kehamilan atau persalinan tidak boleh membuat pekerja migran kehilangan pekerjaan atau izin

args.en: Working-time limits and overtime apply to live-in care work
args.id: Batas jam kerja dan lembur berlaku bagi pekerja perawatan yang tinggal di rumah majikan

args.en: Wages may not be withheld to push workers to leave
args.id: Upah tidak boleh ditahan untuk mendorong pekerja pergi

args.en: The state may set minimum terms for domestic workers’ contracts
args.id: Negara boleh menetapkan syarat minimum kontrak pekerja rumah tangga

args.en: Fundamental rights protect non-citizens, not only citizens
args.id: Hak dasar melindungi bukan warga negara, tidak hanya warga negara

args.en: No one may be sent back to a place where they face serious harm
args.id: Tidak seorang pun boleh dipulangkan ke tempat ia menghadapi bahaya serius

args.en: Excluding domestic workers from labour protection is discrimination
args.id: Mengecualikan pekerja rumah tangga dari perlindungan kerja adalah diskriminasi

args.en: Random migration checks breach freedom of movement and lead to profiling
args.id: Pemeriksaan imigrasi acak melanggar kebebasan bergerak dan memicu profil rasial

args.en: The state must prove that a person is a foreigner before treating them as one
args.id: Negara wajib membuktikan seseorang orang asing sebelum memperlakukannya demikian

args.en: Trafficked people must not be punished for offences they were forced to commit
args.id: Korban perdagangan orang tidak boleh dihukum atas pelanggaran yang dipaksakan kepada mereka

args.en: Migrant workers abroad keep the right to vote at home
args.id: Pekerja migran di luar negeri tetap berhak memilih di negaranya

tools.id: Melihat ke depan: insentif ke depan
tools.ch: Farnsworth ch. 1, Ex ante and ex post
tools.def: The court asks what its ruling will encourage or deter in future, for example whether denying a claim would reward employers who hire workers without papers.
tools.def_id: Pengadilan menimbang apa yang akan didorong atau dicegah putusannya di masa depan, misalnya apakah menolak gugatan justru menguntungkan majikan yang mempekerjakan pekerja tanpa dokumen.

tools.en: Purpose and policy of the rule
tools.ch: Neumann, Margolis and Stanchi, Legal Reasoning and Legal Writing, on policy arguments
tools.def: The court reasons from what the rule is for, such as protecting workers who cannot bargain on equal terms, and asks which result serves that purpose.
tools.def_id: Pengadilan bernalar dari untuk apa aturan itu dibuat, seperti melindungi pekerja yang tidak dapat berunding secara setara, dan menimbang hasil mana yang memenuhi tujuan itu.

tools.ch: Farnsworth ch. 5, The least cost avoider
tools.def: Responsibility is placed on the party best able to prevent the harm at the lowest cost, such as the recruiter, the employer or the state.
tools.def_id: Tanggung jawab dibebankan kepada pihak yang paling mampu mencegah kerugian dengan biaya terendah, seperti perekrut, majikan atau negara.

tools.def: The court deals with someone acting for another, such as a recruitment agency acting for a foreign employer, and with who answers for the agent's conduct.
tools.def_id: Pengadilan menangani pihak yang bertindak untuk pihak lain, seperti agen perekrutan yang bertindak untuk majikan asing, dan siapa yang bertanggung jawab atas perbuatan agen itu.

tools.def: The court lays down or applies a fixed, easily checked rule, such as a time limit on detention or a category that is always covered.
tools.def_id: Pengadilan menetapkan atau menerapkan aturan yang pasti dan mudah diperiksa, seperti batas waktu penahanan atau golongan yang selalu dilindungi.

tools.def: The court calls for an individual assessment of the facts, such as reasonableness, proportionality or a person's own circumstances, instead of a blanket rule.
tools.def_id: Pengadilan meminta penilaian fakta secara individual, seperti kewajaran, proporsionalitas atau keadaan orang itu sendiri, bukan aturan pukul rata.

tools.ch: Farnsworth ch. 18, Slippery slopes; Schlag and Skover pt 2 (parade of horribles)
tools.def: One side argues that accepting a claim would lead step by step to wider results; the court accepts or answers the argument.
tools.def_id: Salah satu pihak berargumen bahwa menerima gugatan akan berujung selangkah demi selangkah pada akibat yang lebih luas; pengadilan menerima atau menjawab argumen itu.

tools.ch: Schlag and Skover pt 2; Schauer ch. 5, Analogies
tools.def: The court treats the case as like, or unlike, another situation, for example likening tied employment to servitude or migrant workers to citizen workers, and the other side may call the analogy false.
tools.def_id: Pengadilan memperlakukan perkara sebagai serupa, atau tidak serupa, dengan keadaan lain, misalnya menyamakan kerja yang terikat dengan perhambaan atau pekerja migran dengan pekerja warga negara, dan pihak lain dapat menyebut analogi itu keliru.

tools.ch: Schlag and Skover pt 2, Attacks on levels of abstraction
tools.def: The result depends on how broadly the right or the question is framed: as a general guarantee to every person, or narrowly as a claim by one group in one setting.
tools.def_id: Hasil perkara bergantung pada seberapa luas hak atau pertanyaannya dirumuskan: sebagai jaminan umum bagi setiap orang, atau secara sempit sebagai tuntutan satu kelompok dalam satu keadaan.

tools.en: Kind of remedy: stop the act or pay for it
tools.id: Jenis pemulihan: hentikan perbuatan atau bayar ganti rugi
tools.ch: Farnsworth ch. 20, Property rules and liability rules
tools.def: The court chooses between protecting the right outright (release, reinstatement, a ban on removal) and letting it be taken against payment (damages, back pay).
tools.def_id: Pengadilan memilih antara melindungi hak secara langsung (pembebasan, pemulihan kerja, larangan pengusiran) dan membolehkan hak diambil dengan pembayaran (ganti rugi, upah tertunggak).

tools.def: The case turns on the point of comparison: whether migrant workers are measured against citizens, against other workers, or against no protection at all.
tools.def_id: Perkara bergantung pada titik pembanding: apakah pekerja migran diukur terhadap warga negara, terhadap pekerja lain, atau terhadap tiadanya perlindungan sama sekali.

tools.en: Procedure: who may decide, and when
tools.id: Prosedur: siapa yang berwenang, dan kapan
tools.ch: Trachtman ch. 3, Arguing in a legal system: procedure
tools.def: The case turns on jurisdiction, standing, admissibility, time limits or exhaustion of remedies, rather than on the merits alone.
tools.def_id: Perkara bergantung pada kewenangan mengadili, kedudukan hukum, dapat diterimanya permohonan, tenggat waktu atau upaya hukum yang harus ditempuh lebih dulu, bukan hanya pada pokok perkara.

tools.ch: Trachtman ch. 4; Giltrow and others (eds), Legal Meanings; Brewer (ed.) 1998 (Frankfurter, Llewellyn, Miller); Sankari 2013 ch. 3 (wording, scheme, spirit)
tools.def: The court settles what the words of a statute, constitution, treaty or contract mean, by their wording, their purpose or their place in the whole instrument, or fills a gap the text left open.
tools.def_id: Pengadilan menentukan arti kata-kata undang-undang, konstitusi, perjanjian internasional atau kontrak, menurut bunyi, tujuan atau kedudukannya dalam keseluruhan instrumen, atau mengisi celah yang dibiarkan teks.

tools.ch: Trachtman ch. 5; Schauer ch. 3; Brewer (ed.) 1998 (Goodhart on the ratio decidendi); Sankari 2013 ch. 4 (lines of cases)
tools.def: The court relies on, extends, distinguishes or departs from earlier decisions, its own or those of other courts and treaty bodies.
tools.def_id: Pengadilan bersandar pada, memperluas, membedakan atau meninggalkan putusan terdahulu, baik putusannya sendiri maupun putusan pengadilan dan badan traktat lain.

tools.def: A national court relies on treaties, the views of treaty bodies, or judgments of foreign, regional or international courts, whether as binding law or as persuasive support.
tools.def_id: Pengadilan nasional bersandar pada perjanjian internasional, pandangan badan traktat, atau putusan pengadilan asing, regional atau internasional, baik sebagai hukum yang mengikat maupun sebagai dukungan yang meyakinkan.

tools.ch: Trachtman ch. 8, Arguing about substantive responsibility
tools.def: The court looks past the label or formal arrangement, such as a signed contract, a worker's apparent consent or a scheme's name, to what actually happened.
tools.def_id: Pengadilan melihat melampaui label atau susunan formal, seperti kontrak yang ditandatangani, persetujuan pekerja yang tampak atau nama suatu skema, kepada apa yang sebenarnya terjadi.

tools.ch: Farnsworth chs 27–28; Trachtman ch. 6, Arguing about facts
tools.def: The outcome depends on who must prove what, and how surely: for example the state proving that someone is a foreigner, or a presumption that a trafficked person acted under compulsion.
tools.def_id: Hasil perkara bergantung pada siapa yang harus membuktikan apa, dan seberapa pasti: misalnya negara membuktikan bahwa seseorang adalah orang asing, atau praduga bahwa korban perdagangan orang bertindak karena terpaksa.

codebook.def: Stable identifier of the decision entry
Case name as commonly cited
Court or body that decided
national = a domestic court; regional = a regional human rights court; international = a global court or treaty body
For national courts: destination = the country where the migrant worked; origin = the worker’s own country. Regional and international bodies are coded as such
Place of the court in its hierarchy
codebook.vals: apex | appeal | first | regional | advisory | international

codebook.def: ISO 3166 code of the state whose law or conduct was at issue
Region of that state, used for ordering (Asia, Africa, the Middle East and Latin America first)
codebook.vals: asia | africa | mideast | gulf | latam | pacific | europe | americas | intl (pacific includes Australia and New Zealand)

codebook.def: Date of the decision (YYYY-MM-DD; a year alone where the day is not yet confirmed)
Docket or report citation
Sector of work involved
Legal issues, semicolon separated
Visitor-facing situations the decision speaks to
Stage of the migration journey where the problem arose: 1 recruitment, 2 leaving, 3 working abroad, 4 changing or losing the job, 5 return and after

Type of case: criminal = prosecution of a person; private = dispute between private parties (labor, contract, tort), including claims against recruitment agencies and employers; administrative = challenge to a decision or practice of a government agency (immigration, labor, welfare) on ordinary legal grounds; constitutional = constitutional review, fundamental-rights petitions, and complaints to regional or international human rights bodies. Coded by rule from the court, the parties and the arguments, then corrected by hand; to be confirmed by researchers
Result for the worker or migrant side
codebook.vals: won | lost | advisory | unknown (candidates not yet checked)

codebook.def: What happened after the decision: carried = remedy or reform carried out; partly; not = not carried out; unknown = not yet established; none = nothing to carry out (worker lost, advisory, or law kept as it was)
Argument codes made for the worker side with 1 = accepted, 0 = rejected (see arguments.csv)

Reasoning tools (after Farnsworth, The Legal Analyst, 2007): exante | lca | agency | rule | standard | slope | remedy | baseline | proof; see reasoning-tools.csv. Coded by rule from the argument codes and the wording of the question and holding (AI-assisted), full entries only; to be confirmed against the judgment

C = unchecked candidate: name, court, year and topic only, shown with a mark, to be confirmed or removed; S = full entry coded from secondary sources and summaries, pending a line-by-line check against the judgment; P = checked against the judgment
